prompt:
Style: Ultra-realistic mass celebrity arrival scene. Single continuous shot. Handheld camera from crowd perspective. Natural micro-shake. No cuts. Documentary-level realism.
Audio: Only natural environment sound loud crowd cheering, overlapping voices shouting, rapid camera shutter clicks, phones recording audio, distant airport announcements echoing, footsteps, fabric movement, subtle engine idle and revving.
Lighting: Natural daylight filtering through large airport glass panels. Mixed reflections on polished surfaces. Soft but realistic shadows. Slight atmospheric haze for depth.
Main Character: @IMG
Calm, controlled presence. Subtle confident smile. Face identity must remain perfectly consistent across all frames.
Outfit (STRICT LOCK):
Black zip-up jacket (matte, soft fleece texture) worn open
Clean light grey/white t-shirt underneath
Beige/cream tailored pants
Accessories:
Transparent beige square-frame luxury-style sunglasses with gradient lenses
(No branding, no logo, no variation)
Scene Flow
0–3s:
Camera starts from inside a dense crowd behind barricades. Handheld, slightly unstable. View partially blocked by people in front. Multiple phones raised, some screens visible recording. Crowd energy is loud, chaotic, restless.
3–6s:
Camera lifts slightly above shoulder level, still handheld. Focus shifts naturally between heads, waving hands, and glimpses of the arrival gate. Occasional bright flashes from media cameras. Anticipation rises as crowd leans forward.
6–10s:
Security personnel step in, pushing the crowd back slightly. Camera reacts with natural shake. Through shifting gaps, the main character appears in the distance—initially soft and partially obscured, gradually becoming clearer while walking forward with a small escort team.
10–13s:
Subtle handheld push-in (natural movement, not digital zoom). The main character is now clearly visible, walking confidently at center frame. Path is being cleared. He raises one hand and gives a calm, controlled wave with a slight smile. Camera struggles slightly to keep framing due to crowd movement.
13–15s:
Camera shifts and tilts trying to follow. A luxury convoy becomes partially visible: a low-profile angular sports car in front, followed by two large premium SUVs. A security member opens a vertical-style door. The main character enters quickly. Engine revs naturally. Vehicles begin moving forward. Camera lifts slightly as people try to capture the moment.

Camera pushes slowly forward along the arrow shaft. Focus racks across the surface, revealing intricate carved runes, lacquer cracks, and weathered wood grain. 4-9s — Microscopic civilization on the arrow:
Full macro reveal. A tiny civilization of splinter-sized warriors wages its own war across the fletching and shaft. Miniature soldiers in matching East Asian lamellar armor scale the carved runes like canyon walls using ropes and ladders. Tiny catapults along the shaft hurl fragments of dust and wood splinters that arc through the air in slow motion. Rows of micro-banners in red and blue wave between the feather barbs of the fletching, which tower overhead like enormous plumes. Tiny torches flicker along the shaft, casting warm pinpoint glows. Two opposing micro-formations clash near a rune carving, swords sparking. Camera does a slow lateral dolly along the shaft, revealing more of this hidden world, then settles on a single micro-warrior raising his banner triumphantly. Final frame holds on this tiny hero against the blurred, glowing battlefield far below as the arrow continues its endless slow-motion flight through golden embers.

Cinematography: single continuous macro take, smooth weighty camera motion, no jitter, no cuts. Believable miniature physics — tiny cloth banners, ropes, sparks, dust all behave at micro scale.

prompt:
Camera Simulation: 65mm IMAX film, macro-capable Panavision anamorphic lens. Strong film grain throughout. Horizontal anamorphic lens flares triggered by reflections on glass, polished aluminium, and internal component surfaces. Warm-neutral key light from above camera-right — clean, approachable, matching Pixel’s brand tone. Deep black void. Subtle warm rim light lifts dark components from background.
Single continuous 7-second shot. No cuts. The camera faces the Pixel, flies through the exploding internals, rotates 180°, and watches them reassemble from the front.
00:00–00:01 — The Break
A Google Pixel 10 floats in the void, rotating slowly. Every seam illuminates with a thin white light — a beat of silence — then the phone erupts apart. Every component separates outward along its assembly axis in a controlled explosion. Speed ramps to 180%.
00:01–00:03 — The Fly-Through
The camera accelerates into the expanding cloud. It threads between the aluminium frame, camera modules, processor, memory stacks, ribbon cables, haptic motor, fingerprint sensor, and USB-C housing — each piece flashing bright as the camera passes. It flies directly between two camera bar lens elements, close enough to catch the anti-reflective coating shimmering purple and green.
00:03–00:04 — The Turn
Speed drops to 40%. The camera executes a smooth 180° whip turn — component highlights streaking into horizontal motion blur. It settles facing the entire field of suspended components simultaneously. A wide anamorphic flare streaks across from the brightest internal reflection.
00:04–00:06 — The Rebuild
Speed ramps to 200%. Every component reverses and accelerates inward. Motherboard arrives first, battery slides flat, camera bar lens stack and seat with mechanical precision, frame rails connect at their corners. Speed drops to 30% for final moments — the back glass descends and presses flush with a micro burst of dust. The display floats in, seats, and illuminates on contact.
00:06–00:06.5 — Product Hold
Speed drops to 20%. Camera settles into a classic three-quarter angle. The camera bar catches a clean horizontal line. Screen glows. Void falls to pure black. Hold.
00:06.5–00:07 — End Card
Smash cut to black. Google “G” logo fades in centred, full colour. Below it: “Pixel 10 — built for every moment”. Film grain. Hold.

variants.text:
摄像机模拟：65mm IMAX 胶片，具备微距能力的 Panavision 变形镜头。全程带有强烈的胶片颗粒感。玻璃、抛光铝材及内部组件表面反射触发水平变形镜头光晕。来自摄像机右上方暖中性色调的主光——干净、亲和，符合 Pixel 的品牌基调。深邃的黑色背景。微妙的暖色轮廓光将深色组件从背景中凸显出来。
7 秒单镜头连续拍摄。无剪辑。摄像机正对 Pixel，穿过爆炸的内部结构，旋转 180°，并从正面观察它们重组的过程。
00:00–00:01 — 破碎
一部 Google Pixel 10 悬浮在虚空中，缓慢旋转。每一条接缝都闪烁着微弱的白光——静止一拍——随后手机瞬间炸开。每一个组件沿着各自的装配轴向外分离，形成受控的爆炸效果。速度提升至 180%。
00:01–00:03 — 穿梭
摄像机加速进入膨胀的组件云中。它穿梭于铝制框架、摄像头模组、处理器、内存堆栈、排线、触觉马达、指纹传感器和 USB-C 接口之间——摄像机经过时，每个部件都闪烁着亮光。它直接从两个摄像头模组镜片之间穿过，距离近到可以捕捉到防反射涂层闪烁的紫色和绿色光泽。
00:03–00:04 — 转向
速度降至 40%。摄像机执行平滑的 180° 甩镜头——组件高光拉出水平运动模糊。随后摄像机稳定下来，同时面对整个悬浮的组件场。一道宽广的变形光晕从最亮处的内部反射中横向划过。
00:04–00:06 — 重组
速度提升至 200%。每个组件反向加速向内汇聚。主板首先到位，电池平稳滑入，摄像头模组镜片堆栈和底座以机械般的精度归位，框架导轨在拐角处连接。最后时刻速度降至 30%——背部玻璃落下并压平，伴随微小的尘埃爆裂效果。显示屏浮入、就位，并在接触瞬间点亮。
00:06–00:06.5 — 产品定格
速度降至 20%。摄像机稳定在经典的四分之三角度。摄像头模组捕捉到一条干净的水平线。屏幕发光。背景沉入纯黑。保持。
00:06.5–00:07 — 结尾画面
快速切至黑屏。Google “G” Logo 居中淡入，全彩显示。下方文字：“Pixel 10 — built for every moment”。胶片颗粒感。保持。

prompt:
Create a high-quality 4K cinematic action movie storyboard with EXACTLY 8 PANELS ONLY (no more, no less), showing a female protagonist in a realistic fight sequence where she wins. Use dramatic lighting, high contrast shadows, realistic environments (abandoned warehouse, rooftop, or underground fight arena), and a gritty film tone. No text anywhere.
The storyboard must include exactly these 8 scenes:
Wide establishing shot of a dark, intense location (rain, dust, or low light atmosphere), both fighters facing each other
Close-up of the woman’s focused expression, controlled breathing, tension building
Opponent attacks first with aggressive movement (punch or kick)
She narrowly dodges—dynamic motion, fast reaction, camera tracking
Close combat exchange—blocks, counters, and impact moments with cinematic slow motion
Turning point—she reads the opponent and lands a clean, powerful counter move
Decisive takedown—opponent falls hard, dramatic impact, environment reacting (dust, water splash, etc.)
Final frame—she stands strong and calm, slightly injured but dominant, looking forward under dramatic lighting, clear victory
Use varied camera angles (wide, close-up, over-shoulder, low angle), realistic fight choreography, motion blur, and physical impact details.
Tone should feel like a Hollywood action film, focusing on tension, realism, and character strength—not stylized or social media aesthetic.
Strict rule: only 8 panels, no repetition, no extra frames.

[整体设定]
主题为：街头花式足球表演，非正式比赛，非射门练习，也非多人竞技，而是单人表演者完成的一整套连续花式足球动作。
整体氛围应包括：街头感、城市感、电影感、运动感、酷炫且富有节奏感。

[人物要求]
主角是一位年轻帅气的男性花式足球专家，体格轻盈协调且富有运动感，短黑发，神情自信，动作流畅且具有控制力。
整张图片的 16 个格子必须是同一个人；请勿在每个格子中更换人物。
他穿着具有“酷”感的足球套装，但不能出现“Champion”字样，也不应出现任何特定国家名称。服装应具有职业球队球衣的质感。

[布局要求]
整张图片为 4x4 十六宫格，每个格子必须包含：
1. 大号步骤数字（1-16）
2. 中文动作标题
3. 2-4 个简短的中文动作要点

整体字体风格应偏向运动海报美学，清晰有力，适合社交媒体分享。图像应锐利、清晰且干净；人物和足球都应完整呈现，不得切掉脚部。

[动作序列]
请按以下顺序设计 16 个连续动作，每个动作各不相同，形成完整的花式表演流：

1. 街头开场姿势
动作：单脚踩球，身体舒展，自信站姿，如同表演开始。
要点：主导站姿 / 右脚踩球 / 展示自信
2. 脚底回拉
动作：用脚底将球向后滚动，增加轻微的横向移动。
要点：脚底触球 / 向后拉球 / 轻微转体
3. 跨步绕球
动作：双脚围绕足球进行跨步绕球。
要点：单脚绕球 / 跨步换脚 / 平滑节奏
4. 内外侧运球
动作：使用脚内侧和外侧连续触球，左右切换。
要点：内侧触球 / 外侧触球 / 快速切换
5. 鞋带挑球
动作：用鞋带部位将球向上挑起，使其离开地面。
要点：鞋带发力 / 挑起球 / 球在前方升起
6. 连续颠球
动作：用鞋带部位连续颠球，保持球在身体前方上下弹跳。
要点：交替颠球 / 保持节奏 / 稳定连贯
7. 膝盖控制
动作：利用膝盖或大腿控制球的弹跳。
要点：球击中膝盖 / 控制落点 / 保持平衡
8. 脚后跟挑球
动作：利用脚后跟从后方或侧后方将球挑起。
要点：脚后跟接触 / 向上挑球 / 身体前倾
9. 环绕地球 (ATW)
动作：单脚绕过空中的球。
要点：脚向外绕 / 完整一圈 / 稳定的落地控制
10. 交叉环绕地球
动作：交叉双腿完成绕球动作。
要点：前腿交叉 / 完整一圈 / 空中切换
11. 肩部停球
动作：将球停在肩部或颈部附近。
要点：球落在肩上 / 收紧肩部 / 稳定停球
12. 背部停球
动作：身体前倾，让球短暂留在背部。
要点：身体前倾 / 球在背上 / 保持平衡
13. 彩虹过人
动作：从身后将球挑过头顶，形成彩虹轨迹。
要点：脚后跟挑球 / 球过头顶 / 弧线轨迹
14. 原地旋转接球
动作：原地旋转并接住下落的球。
要点：原地旋转 / 接住下落球 / 轻柔落地控制
15. 脚尖停球
动作：利用脚尖或鞋面精准停球。
要点：脚尖抬起 / 精准停球 / 完美平衡
16. 街头谢幕
动作：再次单脚踩球，双臂张开，如同完整表演的结束。
要点：右脚踩球 / 张开双臂 / 帅气谢幕

[视觉风格]
- 整体高端运动海报风格
- 电影感夜景灯光
- 强烈的动感，带有少许潮流街头美学

High above the streets, a beautiful young woman with sharp short black bob haircut, pale skin, wearing aviator sunglasses, black leather choker with silver chains, green cropped tactical tank top with white "IDWA" text, black harness straps, visible tattoos on arms, fingerless gloves, green cargo pants with knee pads, black combat boots, sits casually on a rusted metal beam hundreds of meters above a bustling neon-lit street full of flying cars and traffic far below.

Sequence exactly as follows:

0-2s: Wide establishing shot of her sitting on the beam, legs dangling, looking down at the city while holding a small object in her gloved hands. She speaks calmly: "Off duty, what are you doing?"

2-3s: Quick cut to medium close-up side profile, neon signs glowing red and blue behind her. She answers: "Waiting."

3-4s: She turns her head slightly toward camera, still in profile, and says: "Got bored."

4-5s: She slowly raises her gloved hand and adjusts her sunglasses with a cool, bored gesture.

5-8s: Sudden dramatic camera tilt downward from her position. She leans back and drops off the beam, falling upside down past the rusty edge. The camera plunges with her, showing vertigo-inducing height, then continues past her into a sweeping high-angle view of the endless city street below with cars, neon billboards, and skyscrapers. Final line spoken over the drop: "Of course you did."

Hyper-detailed textures, cinematic color grading, moody atmosphere, Blade Runner 2049 + Cyberpunk 2077 aesthetic, subtle film grain, dynamic camera movement, 8 seconds duration, 16:9, high motion, emotionally cold and detached vibe.

prompt: 誇張されたカートゥーン調の動きを持つ 3D キャラクター。動きは「スローイン・スローアウト」と「中速加速」を組み合わせ、トランジション間のポーズを「ズーム」エフェクトで歪ませることを強調します。キャラクターは左右に大きな緩急をつけながら高速移動を繰り返し、「移動 → キュートで計算された表情でポーズを決め停止」をリズミカルに繰り返します。制作シーケンス： 「移動 → キュートなポーズで停止」をリズミカルに繰り返す。シーン： 夜の街。画像 1 の少女が車のそばに立っていると、ギャングが現れ、彼女に機関銃を乱射します。彼女は左右に素早く動いて回避し、彼らに接近。ギャング A の機関銃を蹴り上げ、背後に回り込み、スローモーションで意地悪な笑みを浮かべます。彼女がギャング A のパンチをしゃがんで避けると、その拳が隣のギャング B に当たり、彼をノックアウトします。彼女はすぐに後方へ跳躍して距離を取り、着地と同時に鞭を取り出し、クールに振り回します。その後、跳ねるように高速移動しながら、鞭を使って次々とギャングの機関銃を弾き飛ばすなど、多彩なアクションを繰り広げます。カメラ： ダイナミックで躍動感のあるカットシーケンス。強い遠近感、誇張されたアングル、キャラクター追従、急加速を組み合わせ、「ビート」とリズムを視覚化します。モーションデザイン： 肩、腰、脚を連動させ、胴体を大きくしならせます。しなやかさと爆発的なパワーのバランスを表現します。

Both samurai begin walking toward each other. Alternating low-angle tracking shots. Close-ups of calm, focused eyes. Subtle hand movement near katana hilt. Controlled breathing, tension building with every step.

Camera slowly orbits as distance closes. Fabric and hair ripple in stronger wind. Footsteps sink into wet earth. No music, no dialogue—only rhythmic steps and rising pressure in still air.

One samurai remains standing. The other collapses out of frame. Wind continues through empty field. Camera holds on stillness, lingering on drifting grass, then fades to black.

prompt:
Create a high-quality 4K cinematic basketball storyboard showing a full sequence from defense to a powerful score, using dynamic arena lighting, dramatic crowd atmosphere, and professional sports broadcast style. The scene begins with an intense half-court moment where a defender performs a clean steal or block, the ball sharply deflected as sweat and motion particles are captured in slow motion. Transition immediately into a fast break: the player recovers the ball, dribbles with speed and control, accelerating past opponents with quick crossovers and footwork. Show close-ups of sneakers gripping the court, the ball bouncing with precise rhythm, and focused facial expressions, mixed with wide shots of the court opening up. Add a key assist moment where the ball is passed sharply between defenders, followed by a sprint toward the basket with the crowd rising in anticipation. Build tension with a slow-motion approach to the paint, then a powerful finish—either a high-impact dunk, smooth layup, or clean jump shot. Show the ball swishing through the net or the rim rattling with force, including defender and crowd reactions.
Integrate realistic background audio throughout: squeaking sneakers on hardwood, echoing dribbles, player shouts, referee whistle, crowd murmurs building into loud cheers, commentator-style distant hype, and arena reverb that intensifies during key moments like the steal, fast break, and final shot.
End with an emotional celebration: the scorer running back, flexing, or raising arms as teammates join, arena lights glowing and crowd erupting. Use varied camera angles (wide, tracking, close-up, POV, slow motion), strong motion blur, and realistic physics (ball bounce, shoe friction, body movement), emphasizing the transition from defensive control to offensive dominance and victory.

prompt:
Cinematic Hook (Mood, Style, Camera Framing):
Dreamlike tone, surreal aesthetic, wide shot with shallow depth of field.

Visual Elements:
A lone, androgynous figure in flowing, translucent white robes walks barefoot across a dune ridge — the fabric trailing like vapor in the wind. Their skin glows with an unnatural luminance, and they leave no footprints behind. The desert is vast and empty, with undulating sand dunes stretching to the horizon, interrupted only by a solitary, gnarled tree with golden leaves that shimmer unnaturally.

Atmosphere and Sensory Detail:
Lighting: Hard, high-angle lighting casts exaggerated, sharp shadows; sunlight refracts through heat haze, causing mirage-like ripples.
Color Palette: Pale gold, bone white, rose quartz, muted sapphire, soft peach.
Atmospheric Conditions: Still air with subtle drifting sand; faint lens flare as the sun flares against the sky.
Textures: Fine-grained sand glistening like powdered glass, the bark of the tree cracked and iridescent.
Implicit Sounds: Whispers carried on a silent wind, the faint crackle of heat distortion.

Choreographed Movement and Camera Dynamics:
Subject Movement: The figure moves slowly and deliberately, arms slightly raised, fingers grazing the air as if tracing unseen currents.
Camera Movement: Slow dolly forward with a slight vertical rise, emulating a floating dreamlike perspective; slight parallax effect as dunes drift laterally in the foreground.

Compositional Language:
The subject is framed on the lower third line, the horizon bisects the top third; the gnarled tree is placed on the right using the rule of thirds. The use of shallow depth of field isolates the figure from the receding dunes, enhancing the surreal isolation.

At 14 seconds, the entire cosmic structure collapses smoothly back into the original spice pile. The finger re-enters the frame, resetting everything as if nothing happened, creating a seamless loop. Transition lighting from warm earthy tones in the beginning to deep cosmic blues and purples during transformation. Sound design should include soft kitchen ambience, rising tonal hum, particle crackles, deep bass whooshes during explosion, and a subtle “time reset” tick at the loop point. prompt:
A deserted street at night suddenly starts going dark one streetlight at a time — fast. Each blackout is followed instantly by distant screaming and violent crunching sounds. A terrified man realizes something is moving between the lights faster than humanly possible. He sprints toward the final working streetlight at the end of the road while shadows race beside him. Reaching the light, he looks around in relief… then realizes the creatures are circling just outside the glow.

Shot 1 (0s–2s) —

Wide empty street at night.

Streetlights begin shutting off RAPIDLY one after another toward camera.

POP. POP. POP.

Each blackout comes with screaming in the darkness.

A shadow darts impossibly fast between the dead lights.

Shot 2 (2s–5s)

A man hears the screams and starts running instantly.

Handheld chaos.

Lights continue dying behind him in sequence as if something is chasing the electricity itself.

Cars alarms start going off.

A shape briefly sprints across a dark gap beside him at impossible speed.

Shot 3 (5s–8s)

He reaches the final remaining streetlight.

Breathing hard.

Darkness surrounds him on all sides now.

Low growls echo nearby.

Then glowing alien eyes begin appearing one by one just outside the light radius.

Moving constantly.

Circling.

Shot 4 (8s–11s)

The creatures start testing the light.

One lunges partially into the glow — black fur, elongated limbs, glowing jaws — then recoils violently.

Another races behind him so fast it creates wind.

The light above flickers hard.

The man panics and backs toward the pole.

Shot 5 (11s–15s) — PAYOFF

The streetlight suddenly dies.

Pure darkness.

Instant screaming and snarling all around him.

Then —

The light flickers back ON for half a second.

The man is gone.

Only the creatures remain standing calmly beneath the light, staring upward toward camera before everything cuts black again.

Key Visual Hook

Streetlights shutting off sequentially toward camera while something impossibly fast moves between them.

prompt:
A packed city bus tears through rainy streets at night. Suddenly the entire floor dents upward beneath passengers’ feet with a metallic BOOM. People scream as scraping sounds race underneath the bus at impossible speed. Sparks blast past the windows. A passenger looks down outside — an alien creature is sprinting upside down beneath the chassis, weaving between axles. The driver slams the brakes. The floor rips open from below as the creature bursts upward into the aisle.

Shot 1 (0s–2s) — THE HOOK

Inside packed moving bus.
The floor suddenly BULGES upward violently beneath standing passengers, throwing people sideways instantly. Metal groans loudly.

A second impact hits immediately after.
Sparks streak past the windows.

Shot 2 (2s–5s)

Bus swerves hard through traffic.
Passengers scream and grab rails.

LOUD metallic scraping races from front to back underneath the vehicle like something huge is crawling at extreme speed below them.

The entire bus shakes rhythmically with heavy impacts.

Shot 3 (5s–8s)
A terrified passenger leans toward the side window.

Outside below:
an alien creature is hanging upside down beneath the moving bus, sprinting between the axles while gripping metal with elongated limbs.

Its glowing eyes snap upward toward the passenger instantly.

Shot 4 (8s–11s)

Driver slams brakes.

Everyone lurches forward violently.

The creature SMASHES upward repeatedly from below.
Floor panels begin tearing open one by one down the aisle toward camera like a zipper exploding upward.

Passengers scramble over seats in panic.

Shot 5 (11s–15s) — PAYOFF

The floor ERUPTS.

The creature launches fully into the aisle in a shower of sparks and twisted metal, grabbing a screaming passenger mid-air.

Bus crashes sideways into a divider.

Final frame:
through the shattered windshield, the bus skids while the creature crawls across the ceiling inside the overturned bus toward camera.

prompt:
Style: Found footage, grainy 35mm home security camera footage.

Camera: Static, wide-angle lens, locked-off tripod perspective.

Lighting: Flat, natural indoor daylight coming from two large windows in the background.

Atmosphere: Raw, mundane, realistic suburban home environment with hardwood floors, brown sofas, and a bookshelf.

Audio: low-quality microphone hiss, loud structural wood snapping, and metallic impacts.

 [ENVIRONMENT & CHARACTER DESCRIPTION]

The scene is a messy living room. A large, starburst-shaped white paint spill covers the center of the hardwood floor. A silver metal ladder lies fallen across the paint.

Character 1: A man in a plain white t-shirt and dark jeans, barefoot.

Character 2: A man with messy hair wearing red and black flannel pajamas.

Character 3: A large, grey hippopotamus in a white porcelain clawfoot bathtub.

[TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND]

0-3s: [Wide Shot] The man in the white t-shirt is seen hanging desperately from a white drum pendant light fixture. The fixture rips violently from the ceiling with plaster debris. The man falls directly into the white paint puddle with realistic splashing physics.

[Sound] Sharp metallic snap, heavy wet thud.

3-7s: [Wide Shot] A massive 4-foot section of the ceiling completely collapses. A second man, seated at a dark wooden upright piano, falls through the hole from the floor above. The piano slams into the floor, emitting a loud, dissonant musical chord.

[Physics] Volumetric dust and white plaster chunks fill the air.

7-10s: [Medium Shot] The piano man sits among the wreckage, looking dazed and confused, glancing side-to-side.

[Sound] Muffled coughing and the clicking of settling debris.

10-14s: [Wide Shot] Another massive section of the ceiling gives way. A full-sized porcelain bathtub containing a live hippopotamus crashes into the center of the room. A massive wave of water splashes across the sofas and floor.

[Sound] Explosive wet crash followed by a deep, guttural hippo grunt.

14-15s: [Closing Shot] Static shot of the total wreckage. The hippo remains in the tub, blinking slowly. The camera remains perfectly still.

[Sound] Water dripping and a low-frequency electronic hum.

A beautiful young East Asian woman with long straight black hair, wearing a loose grey hoodie and grey sweatpants, sits casually on a light blue plastic chair in the center of the room. She has her legs propped up, one foot in black-and-white striped socks visible, and is relaxed, sucking on a bright red lollipop.

Suddenly, a massive pale muscular humanoid monster (white skin, monstrous deformed face, glowing eyes) violently crashes through the window in a shower of glass and debris. The camera whips around in fast motion blur.

The woman’s eyes widen in surprise. She pulls the lollipop from her mouth. A glowing blue energy band appears on her left wrist. Her hand and forearm rapidly transform into sleek, metallic blue-and-copper futuristic robotic armor plating with visible mechanical joints and glowing accents.

The transformation spreads instantly across her entire body: she is now wearing full high-tech powered armor — glossy blue segmented plates with copper-brown accents, form-fitting yet powerful. She stands up smoothly, now holding a massive multi-barreled heavy machine gun in her armored hands.

Low-angle hero shot on her armored legs and boots as she steps forward. The monster roars and charges. She opens fire. Glass explodes, debris flies, the creature is blasted backward in a burst of white smoke and light. A car outside is smashed aside in the chaos.

prompt:
A hyper-real dark-comedy sci-fi sequence set on the bow deck of a grand early-20th-century ocean liner at night. Cold wind, deep ocean darkness, distant waves crashing, faint creaking metal. Sound: wind gusts, fabric fluttering, low thunder rumble building.

Shot 1 (0–3s):
At the very front of the ship, a white cat (elegant, wearing a pink lace shawl and a diamond-trimmed ivory 19th-century evening gown) stands on the railing platform, arms stretched wide in a romantic pose.
Behind her, an orange cat (athletic, wearing a rugged explorer outfit, black leather gloves, and a light blue scarf wrapped tightly around his neck) holds her steady from behind.
Only the orange cat wears a scarf.
Beneath the scarf, barely visible at the neckline, is damp, hairless green skin.
She smiles softly: “I feel like I’m flying…”
Suddenly—a violent gust of wind WHIPS the scarf off his neck into the darkness.

Shot 2 (3–6s):
Close-up—his exposed neck reveals unmistakable wet, hairless green alien skin.
His black leather gloves quickly clutch at his collar as he panics, trying to cover it.
He mutters under his breath:
“Oh you’ve got to be kidding me…”
The sky abruptly darkens—thick storm clouds swirl unnaturally fast. Lightning cracks.

Shot 3 (6–9s):
A blinding flash—revealing a massive UFO hovering silently above them.
Both cats freeze, then slowly turn upward in terror.
White cat:
“What is THAT?!”
They sprint across the deck—heels and boots pounding against wet metal.

Shot 4 (9–12s):
From beneath the UFO—a gigantic green arm shoots downward, stretching unnaturally long, fingers snapping forward at impossible speed.
The orange cat shoves the white cat aside:
“RUN!”
The massive hand grabs him mid-stride, lifting him violently into the air as he struggles desperately.
Orange cat:
“Wait—NOT LIKE THIS—”

Shot 5 (12–15s):
Wide overhead shot—the white cat collapses to her knees on the rain-soaked deck, staring upward in horror, screaming:
“NOOO!!”

Smash cut to interior—UFO cockpit.
Dim glowing green biomechanical environment. Strange organic controls pulsate softly.
The orange cat is trapped inside a giant glass tube.
His head remains an orange cat—but his body is now fully green alien, with smooth wet skin.

Still wearing the black leather gloves, he crosses his arms, utterly deadpan and annoyed:
“So… you happy now?”

Around him, tall green aliens with huge black eyes burst into uncontrollable laughter.

prompt:
超リアルな実写 CM 映像。映画レベルのクオリティ。15 秒。16:9、480p。参照画像（画像 1）の缶コーヒーを使用し、形状、色、ラベルを厳密に再現すること。
[音楽] スタイリッシュなイタリアンエスプレッソに合う、軽やかで洗練されたジャズ（アコーディオン + ピアノ + コントラバス）。やや速めのテンポでスタイリッシュに。
[全体的なトーン] シネマティック、高コントラスト、自然光 + 柔らかな反射光。イタリアの伝統的な石畳の街並み。雰囲気と質感を強調したフォトリアルな表現。
[シーン構成]
シーン 1（0-5 秒）：イタリアの石畳のビジネス街。午前から正午。スーツ姿で疲れた表情の 25 歳のイタリア人男性（ネイビーのジャケット）。カメラの後方からのトラッキングショット（ややローアングル）。男性は参照画像の缶コーヒーを開け、歩きながら飲む。背景はスタイリッシュなヨーロッパ風の建築物。
シーン 2（5-9 秒）：男性の後方から、巨大な雄牛が高速で突進し、石畳を蹴り上げる。ローアングルからの迫力ある疾走ショット。砂埃、振動、重量感を強調。男性は全く気づいていない。
シーン 3（9-12 秒）：男性が缶コーヒーを飲み干した瞬間、スローモーション + エネルギーエフェクト（微粒子/光）。瞬時に闘牛士の衣装へ変身。（華やかな赤と黒の衣装、精密な刺繍のディテール）。カメラが正面にパンし、男性はムレータ（赤い布）を使って迫り来る雄牛を優雅にかわす。動きはスローモーションと通常速度を組み合わせ、キレを出す。雄牛はそのまま直進して石壁に激突し、崩れ落ちる（軽やかでリアルな破壊）。
シーン 4（12-14 秒）：男性は瞬時にスーツ姿に戻る。何事もなかったかのように軽やかに歩き出す。少し満足げな表情。
シーン 5（14-15 秒）：白背景または美しいボケ背景に切り替え。参照用の缶コーヒーが空中でゆっくりと回転する（ラベルが正面を向くように制御）。強いハイライトで輝かせる。
[ナレーション] クールな若い男性の声：「Awaken! Via Espresso.」
[カメラ/演出] 被写界深度（背景ボケ）、適切なモーションブラー、HDR ライティング、リアルな影と反射、シームレスで瞬間的な変身（カットではなく連続的な変化）。
[重要] 缶コーヒーは参照画像と完全に一致させること。人物、雄牛、街並みはすべて超リアルに。過度な誇張を避け、シネマティックなリアリズムを維持すること。
[雄牛の設定（重要/強調）] 雄牛は実際のサイズよりも大幅に大きく設定すること。高さは実際の 2〜2.5 倍（人間の身長を大きく上回り、見上げるようなサイズ）。重量感、筋肉量、パワーを最大化。筋肉の隆起、皮膚の張り、浮き出る血管を超リアルに描写。一歩ごとに石畳が揺れるような重量感。足音が地面に衝撃波として伝わるような重低音。鼻から出る白い蒸気と吐息（興奮状態）。角は鋭く巨大で、危険性を強調。
[演出の強化] 走るたびに石畳の砂や小石が跳ねる。周囲の空気が震えるような圧力。カメラはローアングルから見上げ、異常な大きさを強調。パースを誇張し、雄牛がフレームを埋め尽くす構図。
[リアリズム] 巨大ではあるが、質感や動きは本物の動物レベルで完全に自然であること（ファンタジーではなく、現実に存在するかのような奇妙なリアリズム）。

15–18s — RESET
She lowers her hand. Panel rotates back into place seamlessly and locks flush with skin. Seam becomes barely visible again. No one reacts.

18–20s — EXIT INTO CROWD
She continues forward and blends fully back into the flow of people. Camera lingers briefly as she disappears into the crowd.

prompt:
Cinematic hyper-realistic 14-second night launch of a NASA Space Shuttle at Kennedy Space Center, photorealistic 8K, dramatic lighting, wet reflective concrete pad, epic scale, filmic color grading, no text, no logos.
0-2 seconds: Wide static establishing shot of the full Space Shuttle stack (white orbiter with black heat tiles, massive orange external tank, two white SRBs) standing vertically on the launch pad next to the tall metal tower under a deep dark blue night sky. Subtle ambient lights, calm before ignition.
2-4 seconds: Sudden violent ignition — three main engines and two SRBs fire simultaneously with blinding orange-white flames and explosive clouds of thick white smoke + steam from the water deluge system erupting from the base. Camera cuts to intense low-angle close-up of the roaring engines and orbiter belly, fire and dense smoke rapidly filling the frame, ground shaking, dramatic orange glow reflecting on wet pad.
4-6 seconds: Extreme low-angle close-up on the engines and lower orbiter/external tank as the flames intensify and massive billowing smoke clouds swirl and expand violently upward, thick white vapor pouring out, intense heat distortion, cinematic orange illumination lighting the entire structure from below.
6-8 seconds: Camera pulls back to medium-wide low-angle shot as the shuttle begins to slowly lift off the pad; enormous golden-orange fire and expanding smoke clouds engulf the launch tower base, brilliant reflections on the wet ground, raw power visible.
8-10 seconds: Dramatic wide shot of the Space Shuttle clearing the tower and rising majestically into the night sky; massive expanding clouds of fire and thick white/orange smoke billow outward across the entire pad, tower lit dramatically by the engine glow, epic ascent beginning.
10-12 seconds: Dynamic low-angle tracking shot from below the ascending shuttle, focusing on the three blazing engine nozzles and SRBs producing powerful blue-white exhaust plumes, smoke continuing to surge upward, shuttle gaining altitude against the dark sky.
12-14 seconds: Final wide heroic shot of the fully ascending Space Shuttle climbing higher into the night, surrounded by enormous glowing clouds of smoke and fire that light up the launch complex, dramatic reflections, sense of immense power and scale as it continues its powerful vertical climb.
Style: Hyper-realistic, photorealistic details, intense contrast between dark night and blazing exhaust, cinematic camera movement with slight Dutch angles and smooth tracking, epic and emotionally powerful, no voiceover.

A lone figure stands motionless beneath the celestial storm as the camera slowly pulls back, revealing an infinite world of ice, stars, and living color before the aurora fades softly into darkness. variants.text:
“Duel on the Lake” - Two-segment structure (15 seconds per segment)

Segment 1: Initial Battle on the Lake (0-15 seconds)
Film Type and Format
Type: Wuxia Epic × Qinggong Duel × Oriental Aesthetics
Style: Cyan-blue tones; Jiangnan ink wash artistic conception
Cinematography: Combination of stable and handheld shots; slow motion emphasizes key actions
Audio: Guqin sound; bamboo flute; water sounds; sword breaking the air; staff hitting the wind
Scene Setting (Only valid for this segment)
Location: Jiangnan lake surface; the lake water is cyan-blue; distant hazy mountains and bamboo forest; lotus leaves floating on the lake surface
Time: Early morning
Lighting: Soft natural light; thin mist permeates; water surface reflects the sky light
Color Palette: Cyan, blue, gray dominate; red (female swordswoman) and white (blind swordsman) are focal points
Characters (Locked for this segment)

Red-clothed Female Swordswoman: Deep red silk martial arts attire; multi-layered gold chains around the waist; high bun hairstyle; gold bracelets; slender straight sword, silver-white blade; proud, confident, unyielding
Blind Swordsman: Off-white long robe; black tie; wearing sunglasses; neat hairstyle; long staff (bamboo); calm, composed, precise
Plot (Four Scenes × 15 seconds)
[0-2 seconds] Scene 1 | Confrontation · First Sight on the Lake
Plot Description: Early morning Jiangnan lake surface, lightly covered in thin mist. The red-clothed female swordswoman stands on a lotus leaf on the lake surface, holding her sword in her right hand, the tip pointing to the ground, with sharp eyes. Opposite her, the blind swordsman wears an off-white long robe, his sunglasses reflecting the lake light, holding a long staff, his posture still as water.

Camera Design: Medium shot of the female swordswoman facing forward; medium shot of the blind swordsman's sunglasses reflection; long shot of the two confronting each other
Audio: Low guqin sound; faint water sound; bamboo leaf rustling
[2-4 seconds] Scene 2 | Killing Intent · Eye Contact

Plot Description: Killing intent flashes in the swordswoman's eyes, she raises her long sword, the blade reflecting silver light. The moment the sword leaves the sheath, the blade breaks the air. Hard cut to the blind swordsman's face, sunglasses reflecting ripples, a slight smile at the corner of his mouth. He rotates his long staff, emitting a low wind sound.
Camera Design: Close-up of the swordswoman's eyes; close-up of the silver light of the sword leaving the sheath (slow motion); hard cut; close-up of the blind swordsman's sunglasses; close shot of the rotating long staff
Audio: Sword blade "zheng" sound; staff "hu" sound; guqin stops abruptly
[4-10 seconds] Scene 3 | First Exchange · Fierce Battle on the Water
Plot Description: The swordswoman attacks first, her toes tapping the ground, her figure like an arrow, her red clothes fluttering. She uses Qinggong to step on the water, stirring up ripples and splashes, her sword moves fierce. The blind swordsman moves sideways, gliding across the lake surface with Qinggong, his long staff skillfully blocking. The two exchange blows quickly, sword and staff colliding, water splashing everywhere.
During the fierce fight, the blind swordsman's staff technique changes, the long staff accurately thrusts out, hitting the swordswoman's right shoulder. The swordswoman retreats, clutching her shoulder, her face showing pain and shock.

Camera Design:
4-6 seconds: Medium shot of the swordswoman leaping; close shot of her toes tapping the water (slow motion)
6-8 seconds: Medium-long shot of the exchange; close-up of the sword and staff colliding
8-9 seconds: Close shot of the long staff thrusting out (slow motion); close-up of the hit shoulder
9-10 seconds: Close shot of her retreating and clutching her shoulder

Audio: Water tapping sound; dense collision sounds; wind breaking sound; bamboo flute joins; muffled staff hit; faint painful groan
[10-15 seconds] Scene 4 | Angry Counterattack · Rushing Towards the Bamboo Forest (Ending/Transition)
Plot Description: After a brief pause, anger ignites in the swordswoman's eyes, she growls: "Take this!" Ignoring her shoulder injury, she leaps again, her sword moves even fiercer.
The blind swordsman sweeps horizontally with his long staff, knocking the swordswoman back. The swordswoman flies backward, using the momentum to lightly tap on the lotus leaves on the water surface, flying towards the bamboo forest on the lake shore. The blind swordsman follows closely behind.
The two figures, one red and one white, quickly rush towards the distant emerald green bamboo forest. The camera pulls back, showing the transition between the lake surface and the bamboo forest.

The screen suddenly cuts to black the moment the two rush into the bamboo forest.
Camera Design:
10-11 seconds: Close-up of eyes turning angry; dialogue subtitle "Take this!"
11-12 seconds: Medium shot of the swordswoman leaping and attacking fiercely

12-13 seconds: Blind swordsman sweeps horizontally with the long staff, swordswoman flies backward

13-14 seconds: Long shot, the two figures rush towards the bamboo forest (red and white contrasting with cyan-blue)
14-15 seconds: Extreme long shot, the two rush into the edge of the bamboo forest, suddenly cutting to black
Audio:
Angry shout "Take this!"
Guqin turns passionate
Staff hitting sound
Air breaking sound

Bamboo leaf rustling sound gradually increases
The sound effect stops abruptly at the moment of the cut to black
Ending Design (Engine Six: Abrupt Stop):
✅ Cut to black at the peak of the action of rushing into the bamboo forest
✅ Create suspense: "What will happen in the bamboo forest?"

✅ Drive the audience to watch the second segment

Production Suggestions (Segment 1)
Visual Style: Cyan, blue-gray, thin mist white dominate; deep red and off-white contrast; reduce saturation in post-production, enhance cyan-blue tones
Cinematography: Stable shots (confrontation); handheld follow-up shots (fighting); slow motion accounts for 30%
Sound Design: Guqin main melody; bamboo flute auxiliary; high-frequency sword blade sound; low-frequency staff hitting sound; multi-layered water sounds
Action Design: Female swordswoman "fast, fierce, accurate"; blind swordsman "stable, gentle, precise"; reference 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon' Qinggong
Segment 2: Decisive Battle in the Bamboo Forest (0-15 seconds)

Film Type and Format

Type: Wuxia Epic × Qinggong Duel × Oriental Aesthetics
Style: Emerald green bamboo forest + cyan-blue lake surface; Jiangnan ink wash artistic conception
Cinematography: Dynamic follow-up shots dominate; many low-angle and high-angle shots; slow motion emphasizes the bending of bamboo
Audio: Bamboo flute dominates; guqin auxiliary; bamboo breaking sound; wind sound; sword breaking the air; staff hitting the wind
Scene Setting (Only valid for this segment)
Location: Dense bamboo forest by the lake + lake surface; emerald green bamboo sea; morning light casts dappled shadows through bamboo leaves; cyan-blue lake surface visible at the edge of the bamboo forest
Time: Early morning
Lighting: Morning light passes through bamboo leaves, golden spots of light; semi-light and semi-dark inside the bamboo forest; soft natural light on the lake surface
Color Palette: First half dominated by emerald green (bamboo forest) + gold (morning light); second half cyan-blue (lake surface); red and white contrast runs throughout

Characters (Locked for this segment)
Red-clothed Female Swordswoman: Deep red martial arts attire; gold chains around the waist; high bun hairstyle; holding a sword; already injured in the shoulder; angry, unwilling to lose
Blind Swordsman: Off-white long robe; black tie; wearing sunglasses; holding a long staff; composed, precise
Plot (Four Scenes × 15 seconds)
[0-4 seconds] Scene 1 | Bamboo Tip Chase

Plot Description: The screen quickly fades in from black, directly entering the bamboo forest. The tone suddenly changes from cyan-blue to emerald green.
The swordswoman uses Qinggong to tap on the tips of the bamboo, the bamboo bends and sways beneath her feet. She continuously jumps between multiple bamboo stalks, her red clothes particularly noticeable in the green bamboo sea. Every time she steps on a bamboo stalk, the bamboo bends and trembles.
The blind swordsman follows closely, chasing among the bamboo tips. He swings his long staff, hitting and breaking the bamboo stalks the swordswoman stepped on, the bamboo "pa" snapping and flying.
Camera Design:
0-1 second: Fade in from black, morning light through bamboo leaves
1-2 seconds: Low-angle shot, the swordswoman leaping among bamboo tips, bamboo bending

2-3 seconds: Follow-up shot, the blind swordsman swinging his staff and breaking the bamboo (slow motion), bamboo snapping and flying
3-4 seconds: Side wide shot, the two chasing above the bamboo forest, multiple bamboo stalks bending simultaneously
Audio:
Bamboo bending "sou sou" sound
Bamboo breaking "pa pa" sound

Light sound of footsteps tapping on bamboo tips
Bamboo flute plays quickly (tense)
[4-10 seconds] Scene 2 | Bent Bamboo Duel

Plot Description: The swordswoman lands on a thick, bent bamboo stalk. The blind swordsman immediately lands on the other end of the same bamboo stalk.
The two stand at opposite ends of the bamboo, which bends into a huge arc due to their weight, swaying in the air. Morning light shines on the two through the bamboo leaves.
The swordswoman preemptively strikes with her sword, the sword light thrusting towards the blind swordsman. The blind swordsman sweeps horizontally with his long staff to block. The sword and staff collide fiercely 3 times on the bending bamboo, and the bamboo shakes violently with each collision.
After the 3rd collision, the blind swordsman's staff technique suddenly accelerates, sweeping the staff towards the swordswoman's wrist holding the sword.
Camera Design:
4-5 seconds: Medium shot, the two landing on opposite ends of the bent bamboo (symmetrical composition)
5-6 seconds: Close shot, the bamboo bending and swaying beneath their feet (slow motion)

6-8 seconds: Quick cuts: sword thrusts out → staff blocks → collision (3 quick cuts)
8-9 seconds: Medium shot, the bamboo shaking violently, the figures fluctuating
9-10 seconds: Blind swordsman's staff technique accelerates, long staff sweeps towards the swordswoman's wrist (slow motion)
Audio:

Bamboo bending "ge zhi" sound

Sword and staff collision "dang dang dang" (3 times)
Bamboo swaying "sou sou" sound
Bamboo flute and guqin reach a climax
[10-12 seconds] Scene 3 | Sword Drops · Falling Back to the Lake Surface

Plot Description: The blind swordsman hits the swordswoman's wrist with the staff. The swordswoman's sword drops, spinning in the air and flying out of the bamboo forest, plunging into the distant lake surface. She loses balance and falls from the bending bamboo stalk.
The blind swordsman also leaps off the bamboo. The two fall back to the lake surface from the bamboo forest, one after the other.
The camera follows the two as they fall from the emerald green bamboo forest back to the cyan-blue lake surface—the tone changes again, from green back to cyan-blue.
Camera Design:
10 seconds: Close-up, the sword dropping and spinning out (slow motion)
10-11 seconds: The long sword flies out of the bamboo forest, plunges into the lake surface, water splashes
11 seconds: The swordswoman falls from the bamboo

11-12 seconds: The camera follows the two as they fall from the bamboo forest back to the lake surface (tone changes from emerald green to cyan-blue)

Staff

Shot 1 (0s–2s) — THE HOOK
Empty Indian school corridor at night.
Tube lights flicker overhead.
A classroom window suddenly SHATTERS outward.

Classroom lights flicker wildly.

The skin around her throat moves unnaturally under the surface.
Complete silence fills the hallway.

prompt:
Create a 15-second ultra-cinematic, dark psychological video titled: “What your fear looks like in real life”

STYLE: dark cinematic realism, psychological horror, high contrast lighting, shallow depth of field, slow atmospheric camera movement, subtle film grain, emotional tension.
---
SCENE 1 (0–3s):
A lonely person walking at night in an empty urban street. Streetlights flicker softly. The environment feels quiet but heavy. Camera follows from behind in a slow tracking shot.

SCENE 2 (3–6s):
Subtle distortion begins in the shadows. The darkness behind street corners and walls starts moving unnaturally. Barely visible humanoid shadow shapes begin forming—unstable, shifting, watching.

SCENE 3 (6–10s):
The person starts feeling uneasy and looks around. The shadow creatures become clearer now—tall, distorted figures made of smoke and void-like darkness, silently following but never touching. Reflections in windows briefly show them, but not directly.

SCENE 4 (10–13s):
The fear intensifies. Shadows multiply and move closer. They mirror the person’s emotions—hesitation, anxiety, panic. The environment slightly warps as if reality is bending under psychological pressure.

FINAL SCENE (13–15s):
Wide cinematic shot: the person stops walking, surrounded but not physically touched. The shadow creatures stand all around, forming a circle. One steps closer—screen cuts to black instantly.

---

MOOD: fear of the unseen, psychological dread, isolation, inner anxiety visualized as external entities.

CAMERA: slow tracking, subtle handheld tension, occasional abrupt focus shifts for unease.

LIGHTING: dim streetlights, heavy shadows, fog diffusion, high contrast blacks.

QUALITY: ultra-detailed, cinematic 8K look, realistic textures, immersive horror atmosphere.

The camera slowly moves forward and shows a young South Asian girl walking through the city. Her face and all features must stay exactly the same as the provided reference image in every frame. She looks calm and aware while walking through the strange environment.

In a narrow alley, she lightly touches or passes a stranger. A small magical effect activates. Five seconds of time are taken from the stranger and turn into glowing energy lines that move into her hand. The stranger freezes for a moment, and glowing clock pieces spin around them in the air. The girl stays calm, but there is a slight emotional weight on her face.

Then she stands alone under floating clock fragments. Her memories begin to break and glitch. Short flashes of faces, places, and emotions appear and fade like damaged video. She slowly realizes that every time she steals seconds, she is losing parts of her own memory. The camera stays close and moves slowly to show her emotional state.

In the final part, she continues walking through the neon city. The environment feels heavier and more empty, with large floating clock pieces circling above like a storm. Even though she is losing herself, she keeps walking to survive. At the end, her silhouette slowly fades into glowing neon fog while floating time particles surround her and disappear into the darkness.

[scene2]
斜めからのクローズアップ。片手で卵を持ち、ボウルの縁に軽く当ててから、両手で割る。殻が開き、黄身と白身が落ちる。卵の粘り気のある質感と、ボウルの中での動きを丁寧に描写する。

[scene3]
斜め前方からの手元のショット。包丁でパンをゆっくりとスライスする。柔らかいパンがわずかに沈み込み、断面には細かい気泡が見える。パン粉が木製のまな板の上に少しこぼれ落ちる。

[scene4]

Cold winds sweep across a cliffside packed with Viking-style warriors, armored soldiers, and a roaring crowd gathered around a massive wooden catapult. War drums echo, banners whip violently, ropes creak under tension.

0–2s — Hook:
Low, atmospheric shot over the lake. Beneath the surface, a gigantic crocodile-like creature glides silently, its massive silhouette visible through dark water. One eye slowly rises above the surface. Ripples expand outward. A deep rumble builds.

2–6s — Setup (Loading):
Wide cinematic shot of a colossal wooden catapult mounted on a stone platform. Warriors struggle to load a full-grown cow into the sling, securing it with thick ropes and stretched hide. The structure groans under tension. Dust and hay swirl in the wind. Above, a heavily armored king watches silently, unmoving.

6–9s — Command (Tension Peak):
Close on the catapult mechanism. Ropes are pulled tighter. Wood creaks loudly. One warrior looks to the king. The king gives a subtle nod. A loud command breaks the tension: “GO!” The ropes strain to their absolute limit as the system locks and holds for a split second.

9–14s — Payoff (Bullet Time Action):
Release. The catapult snaps forward and launches the cow into the air. Bullet time engages. The camera rotates around the cow mid-flight as it spins above the lake. Below, the water churns violently. The massive crocodile erupts upward in slow motion, jaws wide. Water explodes around it. It intercepts the cow mid-air in a suspended moment—droplets, debris, and motion frozen—before gravity resumes and both crash violently back into the lake.

14–15s — Final Beat:
Cut to the king. He rises, fist in the air, shouting “YEAH!” as the crowd erupts behind him.

0–2 秒 — 开场：
低角度、氛围感十足的湖面镜头。在水面之下，一只巨大的鳄鱼状生物悄无声息地滑行，其庞大的轮廓在深色的水中隐约可见。一只眼睛缓缓升出水面。涟漪向外扩散。深沉的轰鸣声逐渐增强。

2–6 秒 — 铺垫（装填）：
安装在石台上的巨型木制投石机的宽银幕镜头。战士们奋力将一头成年牛装入投射兜，用粗绳和拉伸的兽皮固定。结构在张力下发出嘎吱声。尘土和干草在风中飞舞。上方，一位全副武装的国王沉默地注视着，纹丝不动。

6–9 秒 — 指令（张力巅峰）：
投石机机械结构的特写。绳索被拉得更紧。木头发出巨大的嘎吱声。一名战士看向国王。国王微微点头。一声响亮的指令打破了紧张气氛：“放！”绳索紧绷到极限，系统锁定并保持了短暂的一瞬间。

9–14 秒 — 高潮（子弹时间动作）：
释放。投石机向前弹射，将牛抛向空中。子弹时间开启。摄像机在牛飞行时环绕拍摄，它在湖面上空旋转。下方，水面剧烈翻腾。巨大的鳄鱼以慢动作向上冲出，巨颚大张。水花四溅。在悬浮的瞬间——水滴、碎片和动作仿佛静止——它在半空中截住了牛，随后重力恢复，两者猛烈地坠回湖中。

14–15 秒 — 最终节奏：
切回国王。他站起身，挥舞拳头，大喊“耶！”，身后的人群随之沸腾。

prompt:
**[CHARACTERS]**

**Lead**: Styled after the reference image — a calm, quietly confident rising star. Clean luxury-casual fit (fitted black shirt or similar), minimal accessories. Face must stay perfectly consistent throughout.

**Security**: 4–5 tall men in black suits, stone-faced, positioned in professional escort formation.

**Crowd**: Students and young fans — energetic, screaming, phones out, pushing for autographs.

---

**[SETTING & VISUAL STYLE]**

Upscale school entrance or campus gate. Golden hour or dramatic natural daylight. Crowd energy in the air — lens flares, dust particles, cinematic depth. Ultra-realistic 4K rendering, true-to-life skin texture and crowd movement.

---

**[CAMERA APPROACH]**

Handheld cinematic with smooth tracking. Strategic slow-motion for emotional weight. Wide for scale, tight for reaction. Paparazzi-style flash bursts throughout.

---

**[SHOT BREAKDOWN — 15 SECONDS]**

**0–2s | Arrival** — Low-angle shot of a sports car pulling up hard and stopping. Door cracks open.

**2–4s | The Reveal** — Lead steps out in slow-mo. Crowd erupts. Phones shoot up. Security locks in.

**4–7s | The Surge** — Fans push forward, security holds the line. Lead stays unbothered — one calm nod. Orbit shot captures the scale.

**7–10s | Autograph Run** — Signs a notebook, signs a shirt, quick handshake. Rare, controlled half-smile. Close-ups on hands and fan reactions.

**10–13s | The Walk** — Hero walks forward flanked by security, crowd still calling out. Backward tracking camera, full hero framing.

**13–15s | Final Frame** — Slow push-in on face. Flash pops, subtle wind. Expression: calm, unreadable, untouchable.

---

**[CRITICAL NOTES]**

Face from reference image must stay identical in every shot — no warping, no drift, no inconsistency across lighting or motion. Celebrity presence should feel earned and natural, not theatrical.

prompt:
High-action jungle escape sequence on a rough dirt airstrip carved out at the edge of a dense prehistoric-looking forest. Harsh daylight, dust, broken trees, deep footprints, improvised runway markings, small propeller plane idling. Sound: engine revving, heavy ground thuds, distant roars, trees snapping.

⸻

Shot 1 (0–3s):
Three backpackers burst out of dense jungle onto a makeshift runway, sprinting in panic.
A pilot stands by a small plane, shouting and waving:
“Come on! Move!”

Behind them, the forest shakes violently—massive trees snapping and falling.

⸻

Shot 2 (3–6s):
They rush toward the plane. One backpacker turns briefly, pulls out a small device, activates it, and throws it onto the runway behind them.
The others climb inside as the engine roars louder and the propeller spins fast.

⸻

Shot 3 (6–9s):
The jungle EXPLODES outward—
a colossal T-Rex bursts through, towering, roaring, charging forward with earth-shaking steps.

The plane begins accelerating down the runway, kicking up dust.

The T-Rex closes in with long, powerful strides.

⸻

Shot 4 (9–12s):
The plane lifts just above the ground—

The T-Rex lunges forward, jaws snapping upward toward the tail—

It just misses, teeth clamping shut inches away.

It pushes forward again, stretching its neck for one last reach—

But the plane climbs out of range.

⸻

Shot 5 (12–14s):
The T-Rex lands heavily on the runway—

A split-second pause—

Then the planted device detonates behind it, sending a massive blast of fire, dust, and debris into the air.

The creature is engulfed in the explosion as the plane ascends into the sky.

Wide shot—plane flying away above the jungle while smoke rises below.

Cut.

⸻

0–2s — HOOK (Mid-Action):
A motorcycle blasts out of dense forest onto a runway.

⸻

2–5s — SETUP (Parallel Action):
Ahead, a small propeller plane is already rolling, about to lift.
Cut to cockpit—woman pilot focused, throttle forward.
Radio:
Pilot: “You have one chance!”
Rider (breathing hard): “I see you—keep going!”

⸻

Back to rider—he steers one-handed, the other hand spinning a rope lasso overhead like a cowboy.
Raptors close in, one leaps, lands, keeps pace.
The plane’s wheels start to lift.

⸻

8–11s — COMMIT (The Throw):
The rider throws the lasso—
it arcs forward in a clean loop—
hooks onto the plane’s landing gear/tire.

The rope goes taut.

The bike jerks; he releases the bike and holds the rope as the plane climbs.

⸻

11–13.5s — PAYOFF (Bullet Time Near-Miss):
Bullet time.
A raptor lunges upward, claws swiping—
misses the rider by inches as he’s pulled skyward.
Dust, debris, and stretched rope frozen in dramatic detail. Keep the Physics Proper.

⸻

13.5–15s — RELEASE:
Time snaps back.
He’s airborne, hanging from the rope, cheering.
Cockpit—pilot laughs, relieved: “Got you!”
Below, the raptors skid to a stop on the runway, watching the plane climb away.

Cut.

The tone is luxurious, warm, and indulgent, with high-end restaurant aesthetics, dramatic macro cinematography, and natural seamless transitions. Every shot should feel rich in texture and movement, emphasizing fire, steam, glossy sauces, and elegant plating.

Audio Design

Use a sophisticated soundtrack that begins with a deep cinematic bass note and soft sizzling sounds. As the video progresses, layer in subtle orchestral strings, crisp kitchen Foley (fire crackles, pasta falling, wine swirl, chocolate drizzle), and end with a warm, satisfying musical resolve. The sizzling should remain audible throughout the cooking shots, blending naturally with the music.

Video Prompt
Shot 1 — Steak Over Flame

Open with an extreme macro close-up of a thick steak searing over open fire. Bright orange flames dance around the meat, smoke curls upward, and rendered fat glistens on the charred crust.

Camera: Slow push-in.
 Audio: Intense sizzling, fire crackle, cinematic bass hit.
 Transition: Flame flare naturally fills the frame and becomes the warm lighting of the next shot.
Shot 2 — Gourmet Table Spread
Top-down cinematic sweep over a beautifully arranged table featuring grilled salmon with asparagus and rice, creamy pasta, Greek salad, and steak with dipping sauce.

Camera: Smooth lateral pan.
 Audio: Music expands with soft strings and ambient restaurant sounds.
 Transition: Camera passes over a wine glass; the circular rim becomes the next shot.

Shot 3 — Elegant Diner

Close-up of a glamorous blonde woman (late 20s, glowing skin, soft waves, glossy lips) holding a crystal wine glass and smiling subtly.
Camera: Gentle dolly in.
 Audio: Delicate glass clink, soft music.
 Transition: She lowers her gaze toward the plate, cutting naturally to her hand.
Shot 4 — Lemon Squeeze

Macro shot of her manicured hand with glossy red nails squeezing a charred lemon wedge over salmon. Slow-motion droplets sparkle as they fall.

Camera: Tilt down following the juice.
 Audio: Bright citrus squeeze sound.
 Transition: The falling droplets match the motion of pasta entering sauce.

Shot 5 — Pasta Cascade
Wide ribbons of fresh pasta tumble from a colander into creamy sauce in slow motion.
Camera: Overhead close-up.
 Audio: Silky pasta movement and bubbling sauce.
 Transition: Steam fills the frame and reveals the next shot.

Shot 6 — Salmon on Grill

Close-up of salmon sizzling on a hot grill as a small flame ignites on its surface.

Camera: Subtle zoom in.
 Audio: Sharp sizzle and brief flame burst.
 Transition: Flame flash cuts into red tomato sauce.
Shot 7 — Rigatoni Toss
Rigatoni is stirred with tongs in rich glossy tomato sauce.

Camera: Circular overhead

制作一部 15 秒的超写实电影级美食商业广告，捕捉从烹饪到享用美食的感官之旅。整体基调奢华、温暖且令人沉醉，展现高端餐厅的美学风格，运用戏剧性的微距摄影和自然流畅的转场。每一个镜头都应充满质感与动感，强调火焰、蒸汽、光泽诱人的酱汁以及精致的摆盘。

使用精致的配乐，以深沉的电影级低音和轻柔的滋滋声开场。随着视频推进，叠加细腻的管弦乐弦音、清脆的厨房拟音（火焰噼啪声、意面落入锅中声、红酒摇晃声、巧克力淋酱声），并以温暖、满足的音乐收尾。烹饪镜头中应始终保持清晰的滋滋声，并与音乐自然融合。

镜头 6 — 烤架上的三文鱼

特写三文鱼在热烤架上滋滋作响，表面燃起一小簇火焰。

摄像机：轻微变焦。
音频：尖锐的滋滋声和短暂的火焰喷发声。
转场：火焰闪光切换至红色的番茄酱汁。

prompt:
Camera Simulation: High-contrast cinematic commercial style with kinetic typography integration. 50mm lens. Sharp highlights, deep blacks. Motion blur and speed ramps. Typography interacts with motion and camera.

Single 8-second high-energy sequence. Fast rhythm with controlled pauses. Seamless motion.

00:00–00:00.5 · Typographic Impact Hook
Black screen → bold text slams into frame:
“TIME.”
Large, uppercase, centered. Immediate impact. Slight motion blur.

00:00–00:01 · First Product Flash
The watch streaks past frame with motion blur behind the text. The word “TIME” subtly distorts as the product passes through it.

00:00–00:01.8 · Kinetic Typography Build
Words appear in sequence with motion:
“PRECISION”
“POWER”
“SPEED”
Each word enters with a different motion style (slide, scale, rotation). The watch appears briefly between words.

00:00:01.8–00:02.8 · Motion Sync
Camera whips around the watch. Typography wraps around the product in 3D space — following its motion path. Words feel attached to movement, not separate.

00:02.8–00:03.8 · Rapid Flash Cuts
Fast alternating:
- macro dial
- bezel edge
- bracelet
Typography fragments appear with each flash, partially visible.

00:03.8–00:05 · Controlled Slowdown
Everything slows. One bold word appears:
“CONTROL.”
The watch rotates slowly behind it. Clean composition.

00:05–00:06 · Acceleration Burst
Camera snaps forward. Typography stretches and compresses with motion. Words trail behind movement like speed lines.

00:06–00:07 · Hero Lock
Watch locks into center frame. Typography fades out except one final line.

00:07–00:08 · Final Statement
Text appears:
“TIME HITS DIFFERENT.”
Bold, clean, centered. No motion.
End hold.

文字随运动依次出现：
“PRECISION”
“POWER”
“SPEED”
每个词以不同的运动方式（滑动、缩放、旋转）进入。手表在词语间隙短暂出现。

00:00:01.8–00:02.8 · 运动同步
摄像机围绕手表快速旋转。排版在 3D 空间中环绕产品，跟随其运动轨迹。文字感觉像是附着在运动上，而非独立存在。

00:02.8–00:03.8 · 快速闪切
快速交替：
- 表盘微距
- 表圈边缘
- 表链
排版碎片随每次闪现出现，部分可见。

00:03.8–00:05 · 受控减速
一切放慢。出现一个醒目的词：
“CONTROL.”
手表在其后方缓慢旋转。构图简洁。

00:05–00:06 · 加速爆发
摄像机向前猛冲。排版随运动拉伸和压缩。文字像速度线一样拖在运动后方。

00:06–00:07 · 主体锁定
手表锁定在画面中心。排版淡出，仅保留最后一行。

00:07–00:08 · 最终陈述
文字出现：
“TIME HITS DIFFERENT.”
粗体、简洁、居中。无运动。
定格结束。

prompt: global_rule: No music, diegetic SFX only. Raw handheld iPhone footage, auto-everything, bystander POV on Rodeo Drive, Beverly Hills, Los Angeles — no styled lighting, no grading, auto white balance flickering between warm and cool as the camera pans across shade and sun. At 0s the camera is already unsteady, pointed loosely down Rodeo Drive, slightly over-exposed on the asphalt, the operator clearly reacting in real time — you can hear ambient noise from the environment, distant traffic, a faint crowd murmur, wind buffeting the mic with a low crackle. At 1s the deep, authoritative low-frequency rumble of an exotic supercar engine rolls in from off-screen left — raw, unfiltered, the phone mic distorting slightly at the low-end peaks — and the camera swings fast to track it, momentarily cutting off the top of the frame and catching a blurred pedestrian shoulder in the foreground. At 2s a matte black Lamborghini Huracán STO slides into frame, the engine rumble stretching into a thick, resonant growl that vibrates the audio channel. The auto-focus hunts aggressively — the car body goes soft and the background sharpens for half a second before snapping back to the car's low roofline. At 3s the driver's window is fully down and Sofia Vale is visible from the chest up — a 23-year-old female prompt engineer with a slim athletic build, sharp feminine facial structure, subtle natural makeup, deep brown eyes, smooth olive skin, glossy dark brown hair loosely tied back with soft strands moving naturally in the wind. She wears a perfectly tailored black fitted top beneath a lightweight charcoal technical jacket, minimal silver jewelry, and sleek modern sunglasses resting casually on the dashboard, every detail immaculate against the raw, unpolished context of Rodeo Drive. Her face is sharply lit by harsh overhead sun casting a hard shadow under her jaw, no fill light, completely natural and unflattering in the best paparazzi sense. Her expression is calm, composed, a barely-there smirk playing at the corner of her mouth, steely eyes scanning forward. At 4s a bystander on the sidewalk — a young individual in an oversized vintage hoodie, loose cargos, and worn sneakers — steps partially into the left edge of frame, half-obscuring the car's front bumper, and calls out toward the open window over the crowd noise, their voice raw and unpolished against the ambient audio: “Excuse me, what do you do for a living?” The camera auto-focus briefly loses Sofia Vale’s face and locks onto the bystander’s outfit before hunting back. At 5s Sofia Vale turns her head slightly toward the window, the smirk deepening just a fraction, her posture relaxed and unhurried despite the slow rolling momentum of the car. At 6s in a voice that is crystal clear, confidently projected, unmistakably standard American English — cutting cleanly above the engine rumble and street noise with natural authority — Sofia Vale says: “I’m a prompt engineer.” The words land with casual precision, no affectation, just clean American vowels and a tone that suggests the statement is both completely mundane and somehow the most interesting thing anyone on Rodeo Drive has said all day. At 7s the camera operator exhales audibly into the mic, a small laugh or breath of surprise, and the frame dips slightly downward catching the car's rear quarter panel and spinning rim in slow motion — the wheel spokes strobing beautifully in the harsh sunlight, lens flare clipping the upper right corner of frame in a raw uncorrected streak of yellow-white blown highlight. At 8s the auto-focus completely loses the car and locks onto a chain-link fence twenty feet behind — the entire foreground goes buttery soft — before snapping back with a micro-jolt at 9s just as the rear of the Huracán begins to slide past frame. Chromatic aberration bleeds purple and green along the high-contrast edge of the car's matte black bodywork against the pale sky. At 10s the camera pans to track the rear of the car — slightly too slow, cutting off the exhaust pipes — the engine note shifting and deepening as the car rolls forward, the slow-motion audio turning the rumble into a cinematic subsonic throb that the phone mic renders with slight clipping distortion on the peaks. At 11s a pedestrian walks fully through frame between the camera and the car, completely blocking the shot for nearly a full second — the operator doesn't cut, just holds and waits, the frame partially obscured by the back of someone's leather jacket. At 12s the car is three-quarters past, the rear wing visible, and the camera is now slightly under-exposed as the operator has tracked into a shaded zone — the auto exposure struggling to compensate, the image briefly darkening and then lurching brighter. At 13s the camera drops almost to waist height, catching the car's exhaust and rear diffuser low and wide, the slow-motion engine sound tapering as the Huracán puts gentle distance between itself and the crowd — still rolling slowly, window still down, Sofia Vale’s silhouette just barely visible in the driver's seat, one arm resting on the door. At 14s the phone's auto white balance shifts warmer as the camera swings back into full sunlight, the image going slightly flat and overexposed on the pale asphalt. prompt:
Create a stylized family-feature 3D animated jungle adventure sequence with playful friendship energy, cinematic action staging, and emotional rescue storytelling.

Two young explorers race each other across giant jungle ziplines high above a tropical rainforest canopy. The world feels massive and adventurous — towering trees, rope bridges, hanging vines, misty cliffs, waterfalls, exotic birds, and deep ravines below.

Start with a fun adventurous tone. Both explorers laugh and compete while flying through the jungle canopy side by side. Fast side-tracking shots show them weaving through branches and sunlight beams cutting through jungle mist.

One explorer pulls slightly ahead approaching a dangerous waterfall section. Suddenly the zipline cable snaps violently. The explorer swings out of control toward roaring waterfall rapids and sharp rocks far below.

Shift the tone into suspense and urgency.

Dynamic overhead shots show the broken line whipping through the air while the explorer struggles to hold on above the rushing river. Water spray, jungle wind, and falling debris create chaotic movement around them.

The second explorer instantly reacts — abandoning the zipline and leaping across giant branches and hanging vines. Use dynamic low-angle action shots through mist and waterfall spray as they swing forward trying to reach their friend.

Hero rescue climax: the rescuer launches forward and grabs the falling explorer by the arm or backpack just before both disappear over the waterfall edge.

End with a wide emotional payoff shot near the jungle riverbank. Sunlight breaks through the canopy mist as both explorers sit exhausted, laughing and celebrating the rescue together.

STYLE:
Stylized family-feature 3D animation feel, rounded expressive silhouettes, lush tropical environments, cinematic camera movement, soft atmospheric depth, readable action staging, polished animated-film finish.

MOOD:
Adventurous, playful, funny, suspenseful for a brief moment, emotionally uplifting and triumphant.

CAMERA:
Wide establishing shots, side tracking shots, overhead danger angles, dynamic low-angle action shots, cinematic hero rescue framing, emotional wide ending shot.

MOTION:
Intentional cinematic motion with strong screen direction and clear visual storytelling. Avoid chaotic unreadable camera movement.

「@Reference Image」が実写の場合は実写の出力を、イラストの場合はイラストの出力を生成してください。主人公の顔、髪型、雰囲気、シルエットを維持してください。

主人公のソロハイライトを含め、中盤から後半にかけて、同性の友人 4 人が自然に加わり、5 人組のユニットとしてダンスするようにしてください。4 人の友人はそれぞれ異なるタイプであり、主人公のコピーであってはなりませんが、ユニットとしての統一感は持たせてください。

衣装は、アイドル風、K-pop スタイル、ダンス MV 用の衣装、または「@Reference Image」の衣装など、あなたが設計したテーマやロケーションに合わせてください。4 人の友人は、類似した、色調が統一された、または一貫性のある衣装を着用してください。理想的には、主人公の衣装のカラーバリエーションを着用させます。ロケーションを切り替える際など、必要に応じて自然な衣装チェンジを含めても構いません。

ダンスは、ヒップホップをベースに K-pop、ストリート、クールなラテン系スタイルを自然にミックスしたプロフェッショナルなパフォーマンスにしてください。ソロと 5 人のフォーメーションの両方が魅力的に見えるようにしてください。

ヒップホップを中心に、K-pop のキャッチーさ、ラテンのリズム、クラブのバイブスを自然にミックスした、センスの良いダンスミュージックを自動生成してください。

ロケーションは固定されていません。都会の夜景、ネオンの街並み、屋上、スタジオ、ストリート、クラブ、海、ビーチ、昼間のプール、リゾートプール、ナイトプール、夕暮れの海岸、夏の避暑地など、ダンス MV のコンセプトに合う場所を自由に活用してください。これらに固執する必要はありませんが、頻繁にランダムなシーン遷移を行ってください。

「@Reference Image」を最初のフレームに使用しないでください。また、「@Reference Image」の背景をそのまま使用しないでください。

ネガティブプロンプト：主人公が別人に変わる、友人がコピーになる、人数が多すぎるまたは少なすぎる、顔や手足が不自然、低解像度、ぼやけ、ノイズ、ダンスが見えなくなるカメラアングル、背景が目立ちすぎる、衣装の不具合、反復的な動き、ダンスと音楽の不一致、実写入力に対するアニメスタイル、またはイラスト入力に対する実写スタイル。

0s–2s (HOOK — FACE FIRST)

POV flashlight already LOCKED on a MASSIVE HIPPO FACE right beside a small boat.

Too close.

Eyes reflecting hard.

Water dripping off its mouth.

Someone screams:
 “BACK! BACK! BACK!”

The hippo SNAPS forward instantly — jaws filling frame.
Camera jerks violently.

2s–5s

Camera falls sideways into the boat.

Flashlight drops — spinning beam chaos.

Light flashes:

metal railing

water splashing in

someone slipping

Screams overlapping:
 “MOVE! MOVE!”
The boat rocks violently.
5s–8s (SCRAMBLE — NO CONTROL)

Camera grabs the flashlight again — shaky beam.
Points toward water —

Nothing there.

Just ripples.

Too quiet for half a second.

Heavy breathing.

8s–11s (SECOND PROXIMITY SHOCK)

Beam swings right —

HIPPO already THERE again, closer than before.

Mouth open.

Someone screams right next to camera:
 “IT’S RIGHT HERE!”

Water blasts up as it surges forward.

Light flickers from the splash.

11s–14s (CHAOS PEAK)

Camera gets knocked backward — half off the boat.

Flashlight beam now angled low across water.

We see:
thrashing water

part of the head

nothing fully clear

Sound carries it:
SPLASHES + SCREAMS + WOOD HITTING WATER

14s–15s (PAYOFF)

Flashlight flickers once…

Then cuts out.

Complete darkness.

One final HEAVY SPLASH right next to camera.
Cut.
Key Visual Hook

Hippo face already in flashlight beam in frame one — no search, no buildup — immediate attack.

# スタイル
日本のアニメ調フルカラー、重厚なシネマティック・カラーグレーディング。

# 制約事項
単調さを避けるため、カットごとにアングルと画角を変更すること。

# 設定
場所：昼間の深い針葉樹林。木漏れ日が地面にまだら模様を描いている。キャラクターは太い切り株に座っている。足元には小型ガスバーナーと金属製マグカップ。カップ麺は赤いカップで、白い「NIPPON」のロゴ入り。

# シーン
森の中で一人、NIPPON カップ麺を作り食べるまでの工程。手元の動きを詳細に、テンポよく描写すること。

cut1：横からのマクロショット。地面には NIPPON カップのみ。日光がカップを照らす。環境音：風の音、鳥のさえずり。
cut2：極端なクローズアップ。親指の爪が蓋の端に引っかかり、ゆっくりと剥がれ始める。環境音：蓋を剥がす音。
cut3：マクロショット。地面で小型ガスバーナーを広げる手元。環境音：金属が展開する音。
cut4：極端なクローズアップ。ライターを親指で弾くが、一度失敗する。環境音：失敗した時のカチッという音。
cut5：極端なクローズアップ。二度目で青い炎が点火する。[スピードランプ：スローから点火時に加速]。環境音：点火音、炎の音。
cut6：極端なクローズアップ。青い炎がゆっくりと揺らめく。環境音：炎の音。
cut7：マクロショット。金属製マグカップをバーナーに乗せる。環境音：金属同士が触れ合う音。
cut8：真上からの極端なクローズアップ。水面に最初の泡が現れ、ゆっくりと沸騰し始める。環境音：沸騰する音。
cut9：極端なクローズアップ。指先がマグカップの縁に一瞬触れ、熱さに素早く引っ込める。環境音：軽く触れる音。
cut10：ワイドショット。日光が地面をゆっくりと移動する。静かで誰もいない森。環境音：木の葉が揺れる音、鳥の声。長尺。
cut11：斜め横からのマクロショット。両手でマグカップから NIPPON カップへゆっくりとお湯を注ぐ。白い湯気が立ち上り、日光に反射して輝く。環境音：お湯を注ぐ音、湯気の音。
cut12：マクロショット。手で蓋を閉じ、重しとしてマグカップを上に置く。環境音：蓋を閉じる音。
cut13：マクロショット。NIPPON カップの隙間から湯気が立ち上り、風に消えていく。環境音：風の音、静寂。
cut14：マクロショット。両手で袋から割り箸を取り出し、割る。環境音：箸を割る音。
cut15：真上からのマクロショット。NIPPON カップの蓋を開け、箸でかき混ぜる。湯気が一気に広がる。環境音：箸がカップに当たる音、湯気の音。
cut16：斜め横からのマクロショット。横顔。箸でラーメンをすする。環境音：すする音。
cut17：斜め横からのバストショット。ため息をつき、遠くの木々をぼんやりと眺める。目を細める。カメラがゆっくりと横顔にズームインする。環境音：ため息、風の音。シーンの終わりにかけて環境音をゆっくりとフェードアウトさせる。

prompt:
Cinematic hand-drawn 2.5D hybrid animation (3D base model + 2D brushstroke coloring), 24fps, 13 seconds. The energy gun user refers to image1. The blade user refers to image2, using the blade design from image3. The setting refers to image4.

**Cinematography:**
Multi-shot edit with 6 cuts. 18–35mm ultra-wide/wide-angle lens with strong perspective and distinct parallax. Dynamic handheld tracking with natural micro-shakes and slight footstep movement (no smooth gimbal motion); occasional Dutch angles; fast but readable motion trails and compositions. Character stability is high with no flickering, artifacts, or extra limbs. No text, logos, or watermarks.

**Environment:**
Inside a cyberpunk abandoned shopping mall. Features a shattered glass dome, collapsed structures, blue dust mist, and neon magenta/pink light leaks. Includes damaged escalators, a large open atrium, hanging cables, scattered debris, flickering signs, volumetric light beams, and floating dust.

**Character Settings:**
*   **Gunner:** Full face mask, black clothing with white lightning accents. Fires energy bolts with a "black core + white lightning" texture.
*   **Blader:** Uses an orange energy blade (orange glowing edge + mechanical structure). Agile movement specializing in wall-running, aerial evasion, and lightning-fast teleport/afterimage dashes.

**Action Sequence (13 seconds, 6 cuts):**
*   **Cut 1 (0–2s):** Low-angle wide shot. Gunner moves laterally with high-speed lightning steps, firing three black-and-white energy bolts. Handheld camera follows with exaggerated perspective and ground-level parallax.
*   **Cut 2 (2–4s):** Blader enters with a low-to-the-ground slide, easily deflecting the bolts with the energy blade. Sparks and air pressure rings diffuse outward. Fast whip-pan follows the projectile trajectory without jump-cutting.
*   **Cut 3 (4–6s):** High-to-low tilting shot. Gunner spirals through the air while firing precision shots with electric arc trails. Blader wall-runs up a pillar and leaps over a broken railing, creating strong depth between foreground and background.
*   **Cut 4 (6–8s):** Brief bullet-time (slow motion) as an energy bolt grazes a mask; immediately returns to full speed. Blader uses the blade tip to parry a bolt, creating a clear reflection trajectory.
*   **Cut 5 (8–10.5s):** Blader performs a zigzag teleport dash with trailing afterimages, falling from above for a heavy downward slash. Gunner retreats while adjusting their stance.
*   **Cut 6 (10.5–13s):** Gunner deploys a translucent arc energy shield with their free hand to block the heavy slash. The two clash in mid-air over the escalator void with high-speed exchanges of bolts and blades. A final heavy impact creates a ring-shaped shockwave of dust and debris as both land and separate.

**Effects and Motion:**
Energy bolts feature black cores, white lightning textures, crackling arcs, and air pressure cones. The blade features orange glowing edge + mechanical structure.

电影级手绘 2.5D 混合动画（3D 基础模型 + 2D 笔触上色），24fps，时长 13 秒。枪手参考 image1。刀客参考 image2，并使用 image3 中的刀具设计。场景参考 image4。

**摄影：**
多镜头剪辑，共 6 个分镜。使用 18–35mm 超广角/广角镜头，具有强烈的透视感和明显的视差。动态手持追踪，带有自然的微晃动和轻微的脚步移动（非平滑的稳定器运镜）；偶尔使用荷兰式倾斜镜头；动作轨迹和构图快速但清晰易读。角色稳定性高，无闪烁、伪影或多余肢体。无文字、Logo 或水印。

**环境：**
赛博朋克风格的废弃商场内部。包含破碎的玻璃穹顶、坍塌的结构、蓝色尘雾以及霓虹洋红色/粉色的漏光。场景包括受损的自动扶梯、宽敞的中庭、悬挂的电缆、散落的碎片、闪烁的招牌、体积光束以及漂浮的尘埃。

**角色设定：**

アニメーションは、速く、躍動感があり、不安定で、感情を揺さぶるものである必要があります。すべての変化はシームレスで連続的であること。ハードカットは禁止。単一フレームのインパクトホールドを除き、静止した一時停止はなし。背景を含む構図全体が絶えず変化し続けます。すべての要素は、記憶、重力、熱、音、そして感情によって同時に引っ張られているかのように動作します。

[0-1.5s] 中央の抽象的なフィギュアが、あたかもすでに動いているかのように現れます。その内側の色は不均一な感情の波となって外側に脈打ち、その輪郭は複数の方向に引き裂かれます。背景は、圧力のかかった柔らかい紙のようにフィギュアの周りで曲がります。繊細な手描きのテクスチャが、主要な形状が動くよりも速く表面を這い回り、体と肌の間に緊張感を生み出します。

[1.5-3s] 切り離された輪郭が加速し、神経質な糸のような形状になります。フィギュアの色の核は、鋭いリボンと液体の汚れへと同時に伸びます。リボンの中には跳ね返るものもあれば、前方に鞭打つものもあり、それぞれが震える残像を残します。動くパーツの間の空白部分が新しい形として発火し、あたかも構図が自らの感情的な隙間を埋めるために形を作り出しているかのようになります。

[3-4.5s] すべての形が突然、フレームを斜めに横切って急増します。1つの大きな形状が布のように自ら重なりますが、その折り目からは、粒子、チョーク、濡れたインク、削り取られた絵具など、まったく異なるテクスチャが一度に見えます。背景はその折り目に従い、新しいカラーフィールドへとねじ曲がります。小さな形状は動きに引きずられ、生き続けながら変容し続けるスピードラインへと伸びます。

[4.5-6s] 構図は、穏やか、暴力的、壊れやすい、有頂天といういくつかの感情的な力に分裂します。それぞれの力が他から色を奪い合います。影は、それを投影する物体の前に現れ、予測のように先行して動きます。元の形は自分の影を追いかけますが、影はより速く変異し、物体よりも明るく、厚く、支配的になります。

[6-7.5s] 急速な連鎖反応が始まります。形と形の間のすべての衝突は、リファレンスから取られた新しいモチーフ（断片、シンボル、テクスチャ、シルエット、汚れ、線、カラーフィールド）を生成します。これらの新しいモチーフは、すぐに異なる方向に加速します。軌跡（トレイル）は単に消えるのではなく、新しい物体へと固まり、再び溶け、さらに小さな感情の残響へと分裂します。

[7.5-9s] フレーム全体が、中央下の単一の見えない点に向かって圧縮されます。すべての線、色、テクスチャ、影、背景レイヤーが異なる速度で内側に絞り込まれます。最大圧縮を1フレームだけ維持します。その後、すべてが垂直方向の塗抹、揺れる輪郭、オーバーシュートする動きを伴って、上外方向へと爆発します。各要素は新しい位置に着地しますが、衝撃で振動し続けます。

[9-10.5s] テクスチャが、交換された感情のように形の間を移動し始めます。ざらざらした乾燥したテクスチャが流動的な形に入り込み、それを途切れた角張ったステップで動かします。液体のテクスチャが硬い形に入り込み、それをたわませ、滴らせ、呼吸させます。輝く色のテクスチャが背景に移り、環境全体を脈動させます。すべての形は、受け取ったテクスチャに基づいて動作を変えます。

[10.5-12s] 回転の連鎖がフレームを横切ります。各形態が反転、ねじれ、あるいは裏返しになり、劇的に異なる色と感情的な質を持つ隠された裏面を露わにします。現れた面は、手、フック、炎、波のように隣接する形に向かって手を伸ばします。触れられると、次の形が即座に回転し、フレーム全体が新しい感情の世界に変わるまで、この連鎖はますます速く続きます。

[12-13.5s] 境界がいたるところで一度に溶解します。形が融合し、拒絶し合い、分離し、再び融合します。新しいハイブリッドな形状は、親から色、テクスチャ、動きの動作を引き継ぎますが、決して親と同一にはなりません。背景はもはや形の後ろにあるのではなく、形の一つとなり、前方に押し出し、エッジを飲み込み、自らの内側から新しいフィギュアを放出します。

[13.5-15s] これまでのすべてのプロセスが、同時に最大速度で戻ってきます。輪郭の剥離、色の滲みと滴り、テクスチャの移動、影の先行、形の追跡、軌跡の凝固、隠れた面の回転、境界の溶解、背景の折りたたみ、そしてハイブリッド形状の増殖。各要素が一度に複数の変容を実行します。最後の1秒は感情的に過負荷に感じられますが、視覚的には意図的です。すべてのリファレンスが完全に吸収され、最後のフレームまで変容し続ける、速い手描きの抽象的な嵐です。

抽象艺术动画，手绘风格，情感化的动态变形。{{Image 1}} 到 {{Image 5}} 是 5 个赛博朋克风格的故障艺术构图，特点包括霓虹粉、青色、品红和电光蓝的配色方案、数字故障、像素化失真、异色症般的发光眼睛、数据损毁（datamoshing）效果以及幽闭恐惧般的强烈感。请从参考图中提取所有形态、主题、颜色、线条质感、纹理、节奏以及情感张力。

动画需要快速、动感、不稳定且能引起情感共鸣。所有变化必须无缝且连续。禁止硬切。除单帧的冲击定格外，不应有静止停顿。包括背景在内的整个构图需持续不断地变化。所有元素表现得仿佛同时受到记忆、重力、热量、声音和情感的牵引。

[0-1.5s] 中央的抽象图形仿佛已经在运动中出现。其内部颜色像不均匀的情感波浪向外脉动，轮廓向多个方向撕裂。背景像受压的软纸一样在图形周围弯曲。细腻的手绘纹理比主要形状移动得更快，在身体和皮肤之间产生张力。

[1.5-3s] 分离的轮廓加速，变成神经质的丝状形状。图形的色彩核心同时向尖锐的丝带和液态污渍延伸。有些丝带在反弹，有些则向前抽动，每一条都留下颤动的残影。移动部件之间的空白处像新的形状一样迸发，仿佛构图正在为了填补自身的情感空隙而塑造形态。

[3-4.5s] 所有形状突然斜向穿过画面激增。一个巨大的形状像布料一样自我重叠，但在折痕处，粒子、粉笔、湿墨水、刮擦的颜料等完全不同的纹理同时显现。背景随着折痕扭曲成新的色彩区域。小形状被运动拖拽，延伸成不断变异的动态速度线。

[4.5-6s] 构图分裂为平静、暴力、脆弱、狂喜等几种情感力量。每种力量都在争夺彼此的颜色。阴影出现在投射它的物体前方，像预言一样先行移动。原始形状追逐自己的影子，但影子变异得更快，比物体更明亮、更厚重且更具支配力。

[6-7.5s] 快速的连锁反应开始。形状之间的每一次碰撞都会产生从参考图中提取的新主题（碎片、符号、纹理、轮廓、污渍、线条、色彩区域）。这些新主题立即向不同方向加速。轨迹（trails）不会简单地消失，而是凝固成新的物体，再次融化，并分裂成更小的情感回响。

[7.5-9s] 整个画面向底部中心的一个不可见点压缩。所有的线条、颜色、纹理、阴影和背景层以不同的速度向内收缩。保持最大压缩状态 1 帧。随后，一切伴随着垂直涂抹、摇晃的轮廓和过冲运动向外上方爆发。每个元素落在新位置，但因冲击而持续震动。

[9-10.5s] 纹理开始像交换的情感一样在形状之间移动。粗糙干燥的纹理进入流体形状，使其以断续的棱角步调运动。液体纹理进入坚硬形状，使其弯曲、滴落、呼吸。发光的颜色纹理转移到背景，使整个环境产生脉动。所有形状根据接收到的纹理改变其行为。

[10.5-12s] 旋转链穿过画面。每个形态翻转、扭曲或内外翻转，露出具有截然不同颜色和情感特质的隐藏背面。显露出的面像手、钩子、火焰或波浪一样向相邻形状伸展。一旦触碰，下一个形状立即旋转，这种连锁反应越来越快，直到整个画面变成一个新的情感世界。

[12-13.5s] 边界在各处同时溶解。形状融合、排斥、分离，再次融合。新的混合形状继承了父代的颜色、纹理和运动行为，但绝不与父代完全相同。背景不再位于形状之后，而是成为形状的一部分，向前推进，吞噬边缘，并从自身内部释放出新的图形。

[13.5-15s] 此前的所有过程同时以最高速度回归。轮廓剥离、颜色渗漏与滴落、纹理移动、阴影先行、形状追踪、轨迹凝固、隐藏面旋转、边界溶解、背景折叠以及混合形状的增殖。每个元素同时执行多种变形。最后 1 秒在情感上感觉过载，但在视觉上是刻意的。这是一个完全吸收了所有参考素材，并持续变形直到最后一帧的快速手绘抽象风暴。

prompt:
暗く湿った森の中。映画のクリーチャーのような質感。濡れた傘、ぬめりのある皮膚、深い皺、虚ろな目。映画のようなホラー演出。

キノコは、枯れた老人のような低くかすれた男性の声で話す。
「……人間を見るのは久しぶりだ」
話し終えた直後、表情が苦痛に歪む。
「うっ……」
呼吸が困難な様子で、むせび泣き、苦しげな声を漏らす。「うっ、うっ、うっ……！」
顔がひきつり、目が見開かれ、全身が小刻みに震え始める。震えが激しくなり、濡れた肉が裂けるような音と共に、キノコの傘が中央から縦に割れる。

中から、全く同じ顔をした一回り小さな新しいキノコがゆっくりと現れる。古い外側の皮膚は枯れ落ちていく。
新しいキノコは深呼吸をし、少し活気のある声で言う。「ふぅ、若返った気分だ」

最後は、新しいキノコの不気味な笑みをアップで映す。
超リアル、ダークファンタジー、ボディホラー、映画品質、湿り気、緻密なディテール、ボリュームフォグ、浅い被写界深度、シネマティックライティング、ホラー映画スタイル、9:16 縦型動画。

variants.text:
场景位于阴暗潮湿的森林中。质感如同电影中的生物。湿润的菌盖、黏滑的皮肤、深陷的皱纹、空洞的双眼。电影级的恐怖构图。

蘑菇用低沉、沙哑的男性嗓音说话，听起来像是一位枯槁的老人。
“……我已经很久没见过人类了。”
话音刚落，它的表情突然因痛苦而扭曲。
“呃……”
它继续表现出呼吸困难的样子，伴随着窒息感和痛苦的呻吟：“呃，呃，呃……！”
面部抽搐，双眼圆睁，整个身体开始轻微颤抖。震动愈发剧烈，随着一声湿润的撕裂声，蘑菇的菌盖从中心垂直裂开。

从内部，一个稍微小一点、长着同样面孔的新蘑菇缓慢浮现。旧的外皮枯萎并脱落。
新蘑菇深吸一口气，用更有活力的声音说道：“呼，感觉焕然一新。”

结尾处特写新蘑菇诡异的微笑。
超写实、黑暗奇幻、身体恐怖、电影级画质、潮湿感、精细细节、体积雾、浅景深、电影级布光、恐怖电影风格、9:16 竖屏视频。

variants.text:
Inside a dark, damp forest. Textures like a movie creature. Wet cap, slimy skin, deep wrinkles, hollow eyes. Cinematic horror staging.

The mushroom speaks in a low, raspy male voice like a withered old man.
"...It's been a long time since I've seen a human."
Immediately after speaking, the expression suddenly distorts in pain.
"Ugh..."
Continuing as if having difficulty breathing, choking, and leaking painful sounds: "Ugh, ugh, ugh...!"
The face twitches, eyes widen, and the whole body begins to tremble slightly. The shaking intensifies, and with a wet tearing sound, the mushroom's cap splits vertically down the center.
