prompt: Use @image1 side-view trajectory diagram) and @image2 (top-down trajectory diagram) as the exact reference for the ball's flight path. The red line in @Image1 defines the ball's vertical arc — rising sharply after the kick, peaking around the halfway line, then dipping down hard into the left goal (knuckleball dip). The red line in @Image2 defines the ball's horizontal route — traveling diagonally from the kick spot near the halfway line straight toward the goal in the lower-left, curving only slightly at the very end into the corner. The ball is kicked from the point labeled "kick" and ends inside the goal labeled "goal". Shot count: 4 | Duration: 10s | Aspect ratio: 16:9 CONTEXT: Fictional FIFA World Cup match, Japan vs Denmark. Packed stadium under bright daylight, green striped pitch. A Japanese national team player — blonde hair, left-footed (southpaw), blue Japan home kit — takes a long-range direct free kick. The ball is struck with no spin (knuckleball), so it flies fast and straight, then suddenly dips and dives into the top corner of the Denmark goal. STYLE: cinematic sports broadcast realism, 4K ultra-high resolution, natural daylight, sharp detail, realistic grass and stadium crowd, smooth slow-motion accents, stable footage, no jitter, no distortion, no deformation, photorealistic players. [0s – 2.5s] SHOT 1 — THE STRIKE. Low-angle medium shot behind the blonde left-footed Japanese player. He plants his right foot and swings his left foot through the ball with a clean, flat no-spin contact. Camera: slow push-in. Crowd noise swells. [2.5s – 5s] SHOT 2 — RISING FLIGHT (side view). Side-on tracking shot following the ball as it rises and climbs over the halfway line, exactly matching the upward arc of the red line in @Image1. The ball wobbles slightly with no rotation. @[image1] を使用して完全に固定。主人公はラベンダー色のツインお団子ヘア、紫色の瞳、小柄でちびキャラのような体型。黒と紫を基調とした星の飾りがついたドレス風のコート、リボン、金の装飾、紫と黒の縁取りのソックス、紫色の靴を着用し、全カットで一貫させること。顔立ち、髪型、衣装、装飾、色、シルエットは決して変更しないこと。

主人公と敵は常に自然な人体構造を維持すること。腕と脚は必ず左右 1 本ずつ。高速回転、キック、ジャンプ、着地、宙返りの最中であっても、脚が増えたり、腕が重複したり、足が分裂したり、物理的な残像が発生したりしないこと。モーションブラーは身体の外側に薄く流れる程度に留めること。すべての攻撃は、骨盤の回転、肩のひねり、ステップ、重心移動に基づいていること。

最初は、包囲された静かな緊張感。主人公は腕を組み、無表情で眠たげな視線を向けた後、瞬時に加速する。フィナーレは、敵を空中に吹き飛ばす宙返りキックで、何事もなかったかのように軽やかに着地する。

[音楽]
低いドローン音、鋭い和太鼓風のパーカッション、金属的なクリック音。各攻撃に合わせて短いヒット音を入れる。最後の宙返り直前に一瞬の静寂、キックと同時に弦楽器が鋭く高まり、着地と同時に音が即座に消える。

[カメラ / 演出]
エクストリーム・クローズアップとワイドショットを極端に交互に配置。クローズアップでは目、口、靴の裏、リボン、衝撃の瞬間を誇張する。ワイドショットでは、複数の敵との位置関係と空間全体を明確に示す。ローアングル、魚眼レンズのような誇張されたパースペクティブ、ドリーイン、スピードランプ、マッチカットを多用する。

カット 1：0.0-1.3 秒 / ワイド。廃墟の宮殿の円形ホール中央、主人公が腕を組んで無表情で立っている。8 人の仮面の処刑人に半円状に囲まれている。天窓からの月光が、紫の髪と金の星の飾りを縁取っている。カメラは超ローアングルからゆっくりと旋回し、空間の広大さと包囲の様子を見せる。

カット 2：1.3-2.2 秒 / エクストリーム・クローズアップ。主人公の半開きの紫色の瞳。瞳の中に近づいてくる敵の影が映り込む。口元がわずかに苛立ちで歪む。リボンの星の飾りがわずかに揺れ、完全な静寂の瞬間が訪れる。

カット 3：2.2-3.4 秒 / ワイド。主人公は右前方からの警棒による一撃を最小限の動きで回避し、横を向く。小さな体を沈め、ステップと同時に腹部へ前蹴りを叩き込む。敵は大理石の床を滑っていく。カメラはキックの軌道に合わせて水平にドリー移動する。

カット 4：3.4-4.3 秒 / クローズアップ。靴の紫色の裏が画面いっぱいに迫る。靴の金の装飾が輝き、衝撃の直前に短いスピードランプがかかる。敵の仮面の端が衝撃波で震える。モーションブラーは薄く、片脚のみが鮮明に映る。

カット 5：4.3-5.7 秒 / ワイド。2 人の敵が左から同時に攻撃。主人公は 1 人目の腕をパリィし、回転しながらサイドキックで膝を崩す。続けて後ろの敵に肘打ちを食らわせ、肩のカウンターで柱に押し付ける。カメラは円形レール上で 360 度回転する。

カット 6：5.7-6.8 秒 / エクストリーム・クローズアップ。主人公の小さな手が敵の袖を掴む。金の星のチャームが鋭く揺れる。生地のシワ、指先の力、敵の重心が崩れる瞬間を極端なクローズアップで描写。背景は強い被写界深度で溶けている。

カット 7：6.8-8.2 秒 / ワイド。主人公は敵の腕を引き寄せ、足払いで 1 人を転倒させる。倒れた敵を足場にして低く飛び上がり、回転しながら別の敵の肩にヒールドロップを叩き込む。小柄な体格ながら鋭い重量感。カメラは床レベルから見上げ、誇張されたパースペクティブで靴と敵の距離を強調する。

カット 8：8.2-9.2 秒 / クローズアップ。回転による遠心力で、主人公のお団子ヘアとリボンが遅れて柔らかく流れる。半開きの目の表情は変わらない。背後を敵の短剣が切り裂き、鋭い金属音だけが響く。

カット 9：9.2-10.7 秒 / ワイド。背後から迫る大柄な処刑人に対し、主人公は回転しながら胸部にバックキックを叩き込む。着地と同時に膝を引き、低い姿勢から別の敵の顎に掌底を打ち込む。星座模様の床に敵が次々と倒れる。カメラは一気に引き、一連の処理の全貌を見せる。

カット 10：10.7-11.8 秒 / エクストリーム・クローズアップ。最後の大柄な敵の足が床を砕く。次のカットで主人公の紫色の瞳、続いて靴の先に高速で切り替わる。主人公は低く沈み込み、宙返りの予備動作に入る。音楽が一瞬止まり、髪飾りの星だけが輝く。

カット 11：11.8-13.5 秒 / ドラマチックなワイド + スローモーション。最後のアクション。主人公が地面を蹴り、完璧で美しい弧を描いて宙返りキックを放つ。紫色の靴の先が、下から正確に強敵の顎を捉える。月光を背にしたシルエットで、スカートとリボンが円形に広がる。敵は垂直に吹き飛び、背後の天球儀の光と重なる。回転中も左右の脚 2 本のみを厳密に維持し、人体構造を保つ。

カット 12：13.5-15.0 秒 / 望遠レンズによる引き。主人公は片足で軽やかに着地し、すぐに両足を揃える。再び腕を組み、半開きの目のまま小さく息を吐く。周囲の敵が遅れて崩れ落ち、アメジストの塵が月光に舞う。カメラは望遠レンズでゆっくりと引き、廃墟の宮殿の広大な静寂と、主人公の小さくも圧倒的な存在感を残したままフェードアウトする。

variants.text:
[元数据]
时长：15 秒
节奏：约 128 BPM
构图风格：电影感多重攻击终结 / 极近景与广角交替
镜头数量：12 个镜头
质量：剧场版动漫风格 / 超高端 / 4K / 剧场版动漫，高度精细，电影级灯光，光线追踪，艺术构图，戏剧性的景深，低角度动作摄影，夸张的透视缩短，受控的运动模糊，人体结构准确，无肢体重复。

[服装/主角]
使用 @[image1] 完全固定。主角拥有淡紫色双丸子头、紫色眼睛、娇小的 Q 版体型，身穿以黑紫色为主色调的星形装饰连衣裙式外套，配有丝带、金色装饰、紫黑边长袜和紫色鞋子，所有镜头保持一致。面部特征、发型、服装、装饰、颜色和轮廓绝不能改变。

[身体一致性规则]
主角和敌人必须始终保持自然的人体结构。仅限两条手臂和两条腿。即使在高速旋转、踢腿、跳跃、落地或空翻时，也不要生成多余的腿、重复的手臂、分裂的脚或物理化的残影。运动模糊应仅在身体外侧轻微流动。所有攻击均基于骨盆旋转、肩部扭转、跨步和重心转移。

[世界观]
一座废弃的观星贵族宫殿。巨大的圆形大厅、紫水晶柱、金制楼梯、带有星座图案的大理石地板、透过破碎天窗照射的月光、漂浮的尘埃以及背景中的机械浑天仪。背景统一为冷蓝紫色的月光和金属反射，以匹配主角的黑紫色和金色服装。

[敌人]
多名戴着面具的宫廷行刑者，从不同方向持续进攻。身材高大，身穿黑灰色作战服，佩戴银色面具，手持匕首或警棍。与主角完全区分开，避免看起来像同一个角色。

[氛围]
起初是被包围的静谧紧张感。主角双臂交叉，表情冷漠，眼神慵懒，随后瞬间加速。结局是一个空翻踢，将敌人踢向空中，落地时轻松自如，仿佛什么都没发生。

[音乐]
低沉的嗡嗡声、尖锐的日式太鼓打击乐和金属撞击声。每次攻击都有短促的打击音效。在最后一次空翻前有片刻寂静，随着踢击动作弦乐急剧上升，落地时声音瞬间消失。

[摄影/导演]
极度交替使用极近景和广角镜头。近景夸张地表现眼睛、嘴巴、鞋底、丝带和撞击瞬间。广角镜头清晰展示与多名敌人的关系及整个空间。大量使用低角度、鱼眼般的夸张透视、推拉镜头、变速和匹配剪辑。

镜头 1：0.0-1.3 秒 / 广角。废弃宫殿圆形大厅中心，主角双臂交叉，面无表情地站立。被 8 名戴面具的行刑者半包围。天窗射入的月光勾勒出紫色头发和金色星形装饰的边缘。摄像机以超低角度缓慢环绕，展现空间的广阔和包围圈。

镜头 2：1.3-2.2 秒 / 极近景。主角半闭的紫色眼睛。逼近敌人的影子映在眼中。嘴巴因厌烦而微微扭曲。丝带上的星形装饰轻微晃动，随后进入片刻的绝对寂静。

镜头 3：2.2-3.4 秒 / 广角。主角以极小的动作避开右前方的警棍打击，侧身闪避。她压低娇小的身体，在跨步的同时向腹部踢出一记前踢。敌人滑过大理石地板。摄像机通过水平推轨跟随踢击的轨迹。

镜头 4：3.4-4.3 秒 / 近景。紫色鞋底逼近全屏。鞋上的金色装饰闪闪发光，撞击前有短暂的变速。敌人面具的边缘因冲击波而颤抖。运动模糊很薄，且只有一条腿清晰。

镜头 5：4.3-5.7 秒 / 广角。两名敌人同时从左侧攻击。主角招架住第一个人的手臂，并在旋转时用侧踢击垮其膝盖。随后她用肘击攻击身后的敌人，用肩部反击将其推向柱子。摄像机在圆形轨道上 360 度旋转。

镜头 6：5.7-6.8 秒 / 极近景。主角的小手抓住敌人的袖子。金色星形挂饰剧烈晃动。极近距离描绘织物褶皱、指尖力度以及敌人重心崩溃的瞬间。背景因强烈的景深而虚化。

镜头 7：6.8-8.2 秒 / 广角。主角拉住敌人的手臂，用扫堂腿绊倒一人。以倒下的敌人为踏板，她低空跳起，在转身过程中对另一名敌人的肩膀进行下劈腿。尽管身材娇小，却表现出强烈的重量感。摄像机从地面仰拍，通过夸张的透视强调鞋子与敌人之间的距离。

镜头 8：8.2-9.2 秒 / 近景。由于旋转产生的离心力，主角的双丸子头和丝带滞后且柔和地飘动。她半睁眼的表情保持不变。敌人的匕首从她身后划过空气，只回荡着尖锐的金属声。

镜头 9：9.2-10.7 秒 / 广角。面对从身后逼近的高大行刑者，主角在转身时向其胸部踢出一记后踢。落地后，她收起膝盖，从低姿态向另一名敌人的下巴发出掌击。敌人在星座图案的地板上依次倒下。摄像机急剧后拉，展示整个处理序列。

镜头 10：10.7-11.8 秒 / 极近景。最后一名强壮敌人的脚踩碎了地板。下一个剪辑是高速切换到主角的紫色眼睛，然后是她的鞋尖。主角下沉身体，进入空翻的预备动作。音乐瞬间停止，只有发饰上的星星闪烁。

镜头 11：11.8-13.5 秒 / 戏剧性广角 + 慢动作。最终动作。主角蹬地而起，完成一个完美弧度的空翻踢。她紫色鞋尖精准地从下方踢中强壮敌人的下巴。背对月光的剪影，裙摆和丝带呈圆形散开。敌人被垂直击飞，与背景中浑天仪的光芒重叠。旋转过程中严格保持人体结构，仅有左右两条腿。

镜头 12：13.5-15.0 秒 / 长焦镜头后拉。主角单脚轻盈落地，随即双脚并拢。重新交叉双臂，半睁着眼呼出一小口气。周围的敌人迟缓地倒下，紫水晶尘埃在月光中飞舞。摄像机用长焦镜头缓慢后拉，在留下废弃宫殿的广阔寂静和主角虽小却极具压迫感的身影中淡出。

variants.text:
[Metadata]
Length: 15 seconds
Tempo: Approx. 128BPM
Composition Style: Cinematic Multi-Attack Finish / Extreme Close-Up & Wide Alternation
Number of Shots: 12 shots
Image Quality: Theatrical Anime Style / Ultra High-End / 4K / Theatrical Anime, Highly Detailed, Cinematic Lighting, Ray Tracing, Artistic Composition, dramatic Depth of Field, low-angle action cinematography, exaggerated foreshortening, controlled motion blur, clean anatomy, no duplicated limbs.

[Wardrobe - Protagonist]
@[image1] is completely fixed. The protagonist has lavender twin-bun hair, purple eyes, a small petite physique, a black and purple dress-style coat with star ornaments, ribbons, gold decorations, purple-black striped socks, and purple shoes, consistent across all shots. Facial features, hairstyle, clothing, decorations, colors, and silhouette must never change.

[Human Anatomy Rules]
Protagonist and enemies always follow natural human anatomy. Only two arms and two legs. Do not generate extra legs, overlapping arms, split feet, or materialized afterimages during high-speed rotations, kicks, jumps, landings, or somersaults. Motion blur only flows thinly on the outside of the body. All attacks are based on pelvic rotation, shoulder twisting, stepping, and center-of-gravity movement.

[World Setting]
Ruined palace of star-gazing nobles. Giant circular hall, amethyst pillars, gold-worked stairs, marble floor with constellation patterns, moonlight shining through broken skylights, floating dust, and a mechanical armillary sphere in the background. Consistent with the protagonist's black-purple and gold outfit, the background is unified with cold blue-purple moonlight and metallic reflections.

[Enemies]
Multiple masked court executioners attacking in succession from various directions. Tall with black-gray combat suits, silver masks, holding daggers or batons. Completely differentiated so they do not look like the protagonist's face, hair, or outfit.

[Mood]
Quiet tension at first while being surrounded. The protagonist stands with arms crossed, expressionless, and accelerates instantly with sleepy eyes. The finale is a decisive somersault kick that blows the enemy into the air, ending with a composed landing as if nothing happened.

[Music]
Bass drone, sharp Japanese taiko-style percussion, metallic clicks. Short hit sounds with each attack. Silence for a moment just before the final somersault, strings surge with the kick-through, and the sound fades out upon landing.

[Camera & Direction]
Extreme alternation between Extreme Close-Up and Wide Shot. Close-ups exaggerate eyes, mouth, shoe soles, ribbons, and the moment of impact. Wide shots clearly show position relative to multiple enemies and the entire space. Use low angles, fish-eye-like exaggerated perspective, dolly-ins, speed ramps, and match cuts extensively.

Shot 1: 0.0-1.3s / Wide. Center of the circular hall in the ruined palace, protagonist stands expressionless with arms crossed. 8 masked executioners surround in a semicircle. Moonlight from the skylight edges the purple hair and gold star ornaments. Camera circles slowly from an ultra-low angle to show space and encirclement.

Shot 2: 1.3-2.2s / Extreme Close-Up. Protagonist's half-closed purple eyes. Enemy's shadow approaching is reflected in the eyes. The mouth distorts slightly in annoyance. The star ornament on the ribbon shakes small, then complete silence the next moment.

Shot 3: 2.2-3.4s / Wide. Protagonist avoids an enemy's baton rushing from the front-right with minimal movement. Crouches low and delivers a front kick to the abdomen simultaneously with a step-in. The enemy slides across the marble floor. Camera dolly-pans the kick line.

Shot 4: 3.4-4.3s / Close-Up. Purple shoe sole fills the screen. Gold decoration on the shoe shines, with a short speed ramp just before impact. The edge of the enemy's mask shakes from the shockwave. Motion blur is thin, leg is clearly one.

Shot 5: 4.3-5.7s / Wide. Two people slash in simultaneously from the left. Protagonist parries the first's arm and breaks their knee with a side kick while rotating. Continues with an elbow strike to the enemy behind, then a shoulder-push counter into a pillar. 360-degree camera rotation on a circular rail.

Shot 6: 5.7-6.8s / Extreme Close-Up. Protagonist's small hand grabs the enemy's sleeve. Gold star charm shakes sharply. Depict cloth wrinkles, finger strength, and the moment the enemy's center of gravity collapses in ultra-close-up. Background melts with strong depth of field.

Shot 7: 6.8-8.2s / Wide. Protagonist pulls in the enemy's arm and trips one. Uses the falling enemy as a stepping stone to jump low, doing a half-turn in mid-air to land a heel drop on another enemy's shoulder. Sharp sense of weight despite small stature. Camera looks up from the floor, emphasizing distance between shoe and enemy with exaggerated perspective.

Shot 8: 8.2-9.2s / Close-Up. Protagonist's twin-bun hair and ribbons flow slightly late due to centrifugal force. Half-closed expression remains unchanged. Behind, the enemy's dagger cuts through air, only the metal sound rings sharply.

Shot 9: 9.2-10.7s / Wide. To a large executioner approaching from behind, the protagonist lands a spinning back kick to the chest. Then, upon landing, pulls the knee and strikes another enemy's jaw with a palm heel from a low posture. Enemies collapse in a chain on the constellation-patterned floor. Camera pulls back sharply to show sequential processing.

Shot 10: 10.7-11.8s / Extreme Close-Up. The final strong enemy's foot crushes the floor. High-speed cuts to protagonist's purple eyes, then shoe tip. Protagonist crouches low, entering somersault preparation. Music stops for a moment, only the hair ornament star glints.

Shot 11: 11.8-13.5s / Dramatic Wide + Slow Motion. Final action. Protagonist kicks off the ground into a backflip, a perfectly beautiful somersault kick arc. Purple shoe tip accurately kicks through the strong enemy's jaw from bottom to top. Backlit silhouette against moonlight, skirt and ribbons spread in a circle. Enemy is blown vertically, overlapping with the armillary sphere's light. Exactly two legs, strictly maintaining human structure even during rotation.

Shot 12: 13.5-15.0s / Long Telephoto Pull Back. Protagonist lands softly on one foot and immediately brings both feet together. Re-crosses arms, breathing out small with half-closed eyes. Surrounding enemies collapse late, amethyst dust dances in the moonlight. Camera pulls back slowly with a telephoto lens, fading out leaving the vast silence of the ruined palace and the small yet overwhelming presence of the protagonist.

prompt:

The camera glides between the shadow figures as they silently turn toward the altar. Their edges flicker, sometimes solid, sometimes smoke. Every step they take leaves a ripple across the floor as if the stone were liquid.

VFX escalation: the cathedral walls begin breathing, expanding and contracting with low pressure waves. The ceiling fractures open, revealing a sky filled with rotating eclipses. The sleeping shadows fuse together into a massive winged silhouette above the altar.

Velocity ramp: a stained-glass window explodes inward ,shards suspended mid-air, each shard reflecting a different impossible sky.

Final moment: the winged shadow lowers its face toward the camera, but its face is only a doorway filled with moving stars.

prompt:
Cinematic horror short film, 15 seconds, ultra-realistic, seamless continuous story progression, dark and suspenseful atmosphere, professional horror movie cinematography.

0s–2s

The scene opens in a dark upstairs bedroom at night. A man is sleeping peacefully in bed. Soft moonlight enters through the window, creating long shadows across the room. The camera slowly glides from the doorway toward the bed in a smooth cinematic dolly shot. The house is completely silent.

2s–4s

A faint disturbing crawling sound suddenly emerges from somewhere downstairs. The sound resembles wet claws slowly scraping across wooden floors. The sleeping man slightly reacts. The camera slowly pushes closer to his face. The sound grows louder and more unsettling. His eyes abruptly open.

4s–6s

Close-up on his frightened expression. He listens carefully. Another crawling noise echoes from below. He slowly sits upright. The camera circles around him in a slow arc while the sounds continue moving somewhere beneath the bedroom floor.

6s–8s

He cautiously gets out of bed. Tracking shot from behind as he walks toward the bedroom door. The camera follows closely over his shoulder. The hallway outside is dark. The crawling noises continue downstairs, sometimes stopping, then starting again from another location.

8s–11s

He steps into the hallway and slowly approaches the staircase. The camera switches to a low-angle shot in front of him as he descends the stairs carefully. Every step creaks. The sound below becomes clearer and more aggressive. The camera alternates smoothly between:

Over-the-shoulder tracking shots

Side profile shots

Low staircase shots looking upward

Slow handheld movements that increase tension

11s–13s

Reaching the bottom of the stairs, he stops. The camera slowly rotates around him. Horrific sounds suddenly begin coming from different rooms of the house—first the kitchen, then the living room, then directly behind him. Each sound is matched by subtle camera turns and quick pans toward the source, but nothing is visible.

13s–15s

Total silence.

The man stands frozen.

Suddenly a deep demonic laugh erupts from upstairs inside the bedroom he just left.

The camera instantly whips upward toward the staircase. At the top of the stairs, only darkness is visible. The laugh echoes through the house as the camera slowly pushes toward the darkness.

Fade to black.

Visual Style

Realistic horror movie

Psychological dread

Smooth scene-to-scene flow

No visible monster

Dynamic camera work driven by sound direction

Dark blue moonlit color grading

Volumetric lighting

Realistic shadows

Slow tension build-up

Hollywood horror cinematography

Natural character movement

Seamless transitions

High detail, photorealistic, cinematic 24fps, suspenseful and terrifying atmosphere.

8s–11s

走到楼梯底部，他停了下来。摄像机缓慢地围绕他旋转。恐怖的声音突然从房子的不同房间传来——先是厨房，然后是客厅，最后是他身后。每一种声音都伴随着细微的镜头转向和快速平移，但什么也看不见。

13s–15s

万籁俱寂。

男子僵在原地。

突然，他刚刚离开的楼上卧室里爆发出一阵低沉的恶魔笑声。

The footage is filmed vertically from inside a crowded live audience, with the phone held slightly above people’s heads. The frame has natural handheld sway, small breathing movement, brief focus hunting, mild digital noise, compressed phone microphone sound, ordinary smartphone exposure, and crowd silhouettes blocking the lower edge of the frame.
The stage is a large wooden outdoor performance platform built as a fictional mountain shrine arena: a cracked red shrine gate at the back, carved stone dragon statues on both sides, bamboo fencing, hanging cloth banners with invented calligraphy, dark wooden steps, sculpted rock formations, small ember bowls near the stage corners, and thin theatrical mist drifting behind the set. Tall trees and pale afternoon sky are visible beyond the stage. Audience members fill the foreground with dark hair silhouettes, raised phones, small cameras, and occasional hands pointing toward the stage.
Two original fantasy performers face each other on stage.
On frame-left stands the Crimson Scale Wyrm Guardian: a tall male dragon-humanoid stage performer with a strong athletic build, deep bronze skin visible around the jaw and hands, short backward-curving dark red horns, subtle cheek-scale prosthetics, amber glowing contact lenses, and layered crimson scale armor made of matte leather plates. He wears a heavy dark waist sash, black stage boots, a short thick dragon-tail costume piece attached behind the armor, and a long blackened spear with a red ember-like tip. His movement feels heavy, grounded, and ceremonial, like an ancient fire guardian entering combat.
On frame-right stands the Shadow-Reed Ninja: a lean young stage performer with quick controlled movement, ash-black layered ninja clothing, dark green cloth wraps around the forearms, a plain charcoal hood, a half-face fabric mask, soft split-toe stage boots, and two short curved matte-black blades. A narrow strip of deep green fabric trails from his back and moves with each step. His movement feels light, precise, and tactical, like a forest assassin using speed and misdirection.
0s to 4s: The phone camera rises slightly above the crowd as the audience reacts to the two performers entering their fighting marks. The Crimson Scale Wyrm Guardian steps forward from frame-left with slow weighty footwork, the spear tip dragging once across the wooden stage and creating a brief orange ember spark from a hidden stage effect. The Shadow-Reed Ninja lowers his stance on frame-right, turns one shoulder toward the dragon warrior, and shifts his blades into a crossed defensive position. The audience grows quieter for a moment, then a few people cheer as both performers begin circling toward center stage.
4s to 7s: The ninja moves first with two fast but readable diagonal blade strikes. The dragon warrior blocks the first strike with the spear shaft, turns his armored shoulder into the second strike, then answers with one broad horizontal spear sweep. The ninja ducks under the sweep, slides one foot across the stage, and lets the trailing green cloth flick behind him. Their weapons meet at center stage with a staged metallic clack. A small controlled dust burst rises from the floorboards around their boots. The phone camera jolts slightly as people in front lift their phones higher.
7s to 10s: The duel shifts into a fantasy stage illusion. The dragon warrior plants the spear into the stage with both hands, lowers his head, and the red glow inside his chest armor brightens from hidden LEDs. Thin orange smoke vents from the spear tip and curls upward. The ninja steps backward into a shadowed patch near the bamboo fence, flicks both blades outward, and two black silk ribbons snap open behind him like fast-moving shadow wings pulled by stage wires. The crowd gasps. The camera tries to keep both performers in frame, drifting slightly left then correcting back to center.
10s to 13s: Both performers charge toward the center mark in a controlled stage-combat rhythm. The dragon warrior drives the spear forward with a heavy two-handed thrust while the ninja spins aside and crosses both blades near the spear tip. At the exact contact point, a practical stage flash pops low to the floor, followed by a ring of dry leaves and dust pushed outward by a hidden air burst. The dragon warrior holds a powerful low stance, armor still glowing red. The ninja lands in a crouched side stance, one blade forward, one blade behind. The two freeze in a final dramatic face-off as the audience erupts into cheers, applause, whistles, and raised phones shaking in the foreground.
Camera behavior: continuous handheld smartphone POV from the audience, raised above shoulder level, slightly unsteady but physically grounded. The camera never becomes a professional cinematic camera. It keeps the crowd silhouettes in the lower foreground, occasionally catches nearby phone screens, and follows the performers with natural human reaction timing. The framing stays mostly medium-wide so the full stage combat remains readable, with brief focus hunting when the stage flash occurs.
Lighting: natural late-afternoon daylight from above and slightly frame-right, mixed with warm red practical stage lights hidden inside ember bowls, the dragon chest armor, and the spear tip. The ninja stays slightly cooler and darker near the bamboo-shadow side of the stage. The stage flash briefly lifts exposure on the center floorboards and nearby dust, then the image returns to ordinary phone-camera contrast.
Audio: live outdoor crowd ambience, phone microphone compression, excited audience voices close to the camera, wooden stage footwork, leather armor creaks, cloth ribbon snaps, staged metal weapon clacks, a low ember hiss from the dragon spear effect, a short smoke vent burst, one floor-level flash pop, dry leaves scattering, and loud applause at the final freeze pose.

Keep the Shadow-Reed Ninja’s charcoal hood, half-face mask, ash-black outfit, dark green arm wraps, twin short blades, trailing green fabric, light movement rhythm, and frame-right origin stable throughout. Keep the shrine gate, stone dragon statues, bamboo fencing, ember bowls, wooden floorboards, audience silhouettes, phone POV, daylight direction, red stage glow, weapon scale, and final center-stage face-off consistent from start to finish.

prompt:
Subject: A jungle ranger in soaked tactical gear, sprinting for his life from a gigantic crocodile.

Action/Emotion: Pure panic, survival, desperation, split-second thinking.

Environment: Massive flooded jungle water-treatment plant deep inside the rainforest. Giant concrete water channels, rusted maintenance walkways, roaring spillways, floodgates, pumping stations, tropical storm conditions.

Camera: Aggressive handheld chase camera, low-angle tracking shots, speed ramps during sprints, whip pans, crash zooms, bullet-time during the payoff.

Lighting & Mood: Bright stormy daylight, heavy rain, mist from rushing water, chaotic disaster atmosphere.

Technical: Ultra-realistic, 4K HDR, 35mm anamorphic lens, cinematic motion blur, practical creature realism, blockbuster creature-feature energy.

SHOT 1 — 0–3s (THE HOOK)

The sequence begins mid-chase.

The ranger is already sprinting across a narrow maintenance walkway suspended above a raging water channel.

Behind him—

A gigantic crocodile explodes through a metal safety barrier.

The barrier twists and flies into the floodwater below.

The crocodile charges forward.

Its enormous body sends spray everywhere.

The camera races backward in front of the ranger as he leaps over broken sections of walkway.

A radio on his vest crackles with static.

SHOT 2 — 3–6s

The ranger reaches a junction of elevated catwalks.

He jumps across a gap.

Barely makes it.

The crocodile doesn’t slow down.

It crashes straight through the handrails and follows.

Concrete chunks tumble into the rushing water below.

The distance between them is shrinking fast.

SHOT 3 — 6–9s

The ranger reaches the end of the platform.

Dead end.

Nothing ahead except a giant floodgate control station.

Nowhere left to run.

He turns.

The crocodile advances.

Water dripping from its jaws.

The camera pushes in.

Then—

He notices a massive red emergency floodgate lever beside him.

SHOT 4 — 9–12s

The crocodile charges.

Full speed.

The ranger waits.

Waits.

Waits.

At the last possible second he grabs the lever and yanks it downward with both hands.

Warning sirens activate.

Massive machinery begins moving.

SHOT 5 — 12–15s (BULLET-TIME PAYOFF)

The floodgate blasts open.

Bullet time.

A colossal wall of water erupts from the channel.

The crocodile’s eyes widen.

Concrete fragments.

Rain.

Water droplets.

Everything suspended in the air.

The torrent slams directly into the charging crocodile.

The giant body is launched backward through concrete barriers and into the roaring spillway beyond.

Time snaps back.

A thunderous wave crashes through the facility.

The ranger clings to the railing.

Watching the crocodile disappear into the floodwaters below.

The girl is overwhelmed with excitement as she takes in the bright lights, giant screens, and electric atmosphere.
As the match unfolds, the crowd erupts with every attack and near miss. The girl watches in awe, completely absorbed in the game. Suddenly, a powerful shot sails high into the stands. The ball rockets toward the crowd. Fans duck, cover their heads, and scramble out of the way.

Silence.

Word spreads across the stadium. Even the players notice. One of the star players points toward her and smiles. The crowd begins chanting as she proudly raises the ball above her head. She suddenly becomes the most famous fan in the stadium.
After the match, as fans begin leaving, stadium staff approach her and invite her closer to the field. The star player walks over, thanks her for supporting the team, and signs the match ball. The girl can barely believe it. Cameras flash while fans applaud from the stands.
As the sun sets and stadium lights glow against the night sky, she takes a photo with the player and holds the signed ball close to her heart. Looking out at the field one last time, she dreams bigger than ever before.
Final cinematic shot: the girl walks through the stadium tunnel carrying the signed match ball. She turns back for one last look at the pitch, smiling as the lights shine brightly ahead.

Subject: A dock worker in rain-soaked work clothes, sprinting for his life through a storm-ravaged fishing harbor while being hunted by a gigantic octopus.

Action/Emotion: Panic, survival, desperation, quick thinking under pressure.

Environment: Massive commercial fishing harbor during a violent storm. Towering shipping containers, cargo cranes, fishing trawlers, crashing waves, flying debris, rain-lashed docks.

Camera: Handheld chase camera, low-angle tracking shots, aerial drone fly-throughs, whip pans, speed ramps during sprints, bullet-time during the payoff.

Lighting & Mood: Dark stormy daylight, flashing harbor warning lights, heavy rain, ocean spray, blockbuster creature-feature chaos.

Technical: Ultra-realistic, 4K HDR, 35mm anamorphic lens, cinematic motion blur, practical creature realism, high-budget disaster movie energy.

SHOT 1 — 0–3s (THE HOOK)

The sequence begins mid-action.

A giant octopus is already climbing through the harbor.

Its massive tentacles wrap around cargo containers and rip them from their stacks.

Metal screams.

Containers crash into the docks below.

A dock worker sprints across the tops of stacked shipping containers.

The camera races backward in front of him.

Behind him—

A gigantic tentacle smashes down, crushing the container he was standing on seconds earlier.

SHOT 2 — 3–6s

The worker leaps across a gap between container stacks.

Barely making it.

The octopus follows.

Tentacles sweep across the harbor.

One wraps around a crane tower.

Another tears apart a fishing boat below.

The camera flies through the chaos as waves crash against the docks.

The worker keeps running.

SHOT 3 — 6–9s

He reaches the final container in the stack.

Dead end.

Nothing ahead but open air and stormy ocean.

He turns.

The octopus rises higher.

Its enormous body emerging from the harbor.

Tentacles spreading outward.

Blocking every escape route.

Then—

The worker notices a massive shipping container suspended from a crane directly above the creature.

SHOT 4 — 9–12s

The octopus advances.

Tentacles reaching.

Closer.

Closer.

The worker pulls a crane remote from his belt.

Rain pouring down.

He waits until the last possible second.

Then slams the release button.

SHOT 5 — 12–15s (BULLET-TIME PAYOFF)

Bullet time.

The suspended shipping container drops.

Rain droplets hang frozen in the air.

Steel cables whip loose.

The octopus looks up.

Too late.

The container crashes directly onto its head.

The impact drives the entire creature backward.

Tentacles flailing.

Water exploding upward.

Time snaps back.

A colossal splash engulfs the harbor.

The worker drops to his knees on the container stack.

The giant octopus disappears beneath the stormy water.

Cut.

prompt:
15-second ultra-cinematic dark fantasy transformation sequence inside a lonely artist studio at night.

A human artist sits at a wooden desk under a single flickering lamp, sketching strange occult shapes inside an old sketchbook. Rain taps against the windows. The room is quiet, filled with paper, ink bottles, charcoal, torn drawings, and shadows.

Suddenly the black ink on the page begins moving by itself. It spreads across the sketchbook like liquid darkness, forming eyes, claws, and twisted symbols.

The camera slowly pushes closer as ink spills upward from the page instead of downward, floating into the air like living smoke. The artist freezes, staring in disbelief.

Thin black ink tendrils crawl from the sketchbook onto the artist’s hands and arms. The ink spreads across the skin like moving tattoos, rewriting the body with sharp manga-style lines, black veins, and liquid shadow patterns.

The transformation accelerates. Fingers lengthen into ink-black claws. The face becomes partially covered by dripping brushstroke shadows. Horn-like shapes form from splashing ink above the head.

Pages tear loose from the sketchbook and orbit around the artist. Each page shows animated drawings that move independently, screaming silently in charcoal lines.

The artist rises from the chair as the body becomes a living ink demon -half human, half sketch, made of black liquid ink, paper texture, jagged outlines, and distorted shadow anatomy.

Final cinematic moment: the Ink Demon fully emerges, stepping out from the collapsing sketchbook as the studio walls become covered in rapidly drawing occult illustrations. The creature opens glowing white eyes while ink drips upward into the darkness.

Style: ultra-cinematic dark fantasy, ink horror aesthetic, manga-inspired linework, liquid ink simulation, living sketch effects, gothic artist studio, black-and-white contrast with small warm lamp highlights, surreal transformation VFX, no text, no overlays.

Audio: dark cinematic score, rain on windows, pen scratching paper, ink bubbling, pages tearing, wet ink movement, low supernatural rumble, distorted breathing.

镜头 1 (0-4 秒)
主体：一只成年棕熊突然出现在夜间森林土路上，摩托车第一人称视角正面接近它。
动作：
  0-2 秒：骑手骑摩托车行驶在黑暗的土路上，屏幕底部可见摩托车前部、车灯罩和部分车把，车灯照亮碎石路面。
  2-4 秒：摩托车几乎撞上或轻微碰到棕熊，棕熊受惊并猛地转身面对镜头。
环境：漆黑的林间小路，两侧是灌木丛和树干，路面有碎石和尘土。
摄像机：头戴式或手持手机竖屏 POV，摩托车车灯中心强光过曝，边缘完全漆黑。
风格：真实的野外骑行视频，粗糙、紧张、未经剪辑。
约束：必须明确是摩托车第一人称视角，而非步行视角。
镜头 2 (4-7 秒)
主体：棕熊愤怒地站立起来，骑手在前景掏出一把枪。
动作：
  4-5.5 秒：棕熊用后腿站立，张嘴发出低吼，前爪抬起，仿佛准备攻击。
  5.5-7 秒：骑手迅速从屏幕底部或右下角举起一把黑色霰弹枪/长枪，枪口指向棕熊但未开火。

镜头 3 (7-11 秒)
主体：棕熊看到枪后愣住了，开始尴尬地跳舞以掩饰窘态。
动作：

prompt:

@image1
[条件定義]
約 15 秒、シネマティックで高精度な歴史アクションショート。参照画像の人物を唯一のキャラクターアンカーとして使用し、性別、顔立ち、目の印象、髪型、髪色、年齢感、鎧の構造、配色、布の装飾、武器を維持して、同一人物として描写すること。参照画像が実写の場合は高品質な実写として、アニメやイラストの場合は元の線画、彩色、質感を維持したまま高品質なアニメ映像として描写し、途中で画風を変更しないこと。参照画像の単色背景、立ち姿、待機ポーズ、構図は引き継がないこと。

舞台は夜明け直前、陥落寸前の日本の城。燃え盛る城門から、参照画像の騎馬武者が少数の騎兵を率いて最後の突撃を開始する。主人公は常に先頭にいる参照画像の人物一人とする。少数の騎兵は、その背後や周囲に短く映る補助的な存在である。

[オプション：演者の外見]
命を懸けた決意を感じさせる、勇敢かつ優雅な武者。煙や髪で顔を覆いすぎず、騎乗中も同一人物と認識できるようにすること。鎧、布の装飾、武器を途中で変更しないこと。

[ショット / 流れ]
0.0–3.5秒：崩れ落ちる城門からの出陣。燃える門、崩壊する木製の扉、煙、火花、引き裂かれた旗を捉えるローアングルからの引きの映像。木材が崩壊した直後に騎馬武者が駆け出す。ジェットカットを多用し、目、髪、手綱を握る手、武器の柄、揺れる鎧や布、地面を蹴る蹄を連続的に映す。

3.5–8.0秒：高速加速と矢の雨。超低位置の斜め後方から蹄と前脚を追い、土煙を強調する。顔のクローズアップでは、激しい振動の中でも前方を鋭く見据える表情を映す。高速のサイドトラッキングに切り替え、城壁、炎、旗、敵兵が素早く流れる様子を描写。上方および前方から矢が降り注ぎ、武者は身を屈めて回避する。カメラは前方斜めからサイドへ素早く移動し、立体的な突撃を表現する。

8.0–12.5秒：敵前線への衝撃と突破。行く手に槍と盾の列が立ちはだかる。低い前方位置から、武者と馬がカメラに向かって突進し、衝突直前にカメラが引く。武者は止まらず、槍の隙間へ飛び込むように進路を変え、武器で敵の槍を一度打ち払い、金属の火花を散らす。蹄、目、手綱、武器と槍の接触、鎧、馬の肩、土煙を素早く切り替え、速度を維持したまま戦列を突破する。

12.5–15.0秒：速度を落とさず余韻を残す。土煙から抜け出し、朝日が照らす戦場に向かって走り続ける。背後には燃える城、崩れた門、混乱する敵陣、引き裂かれた旗。前方には黄金の朝日。武者は止まることなく、時折振り返ったり、前方をまっすぐ見据えたりしながら走り続ける。最後にカメラが上昇し、引きの映像となって、先頭の参照人物、少数の騎兵、燃える城、夜明けの戦場を一つのフレームに収める。成功や死を結論付けず、勇敢さと哀愁の余韻を残して終了する。

[カメラ / 編集]
非常にダイナミックな 8～10 カット構成。燃える門のローアングルからの引き、目のクローズアップ、手綱や武器のクローズアップ、超低位置からの蹄の追跡、高速サイドトラッキング、前方からの急接近、斜めからサイドへの回転、敵陣への高速プッシュイン、突破後の上昇する俯瞰映像を使用する。馬の全身を遠くから、またはサイドから長時間固定で映さないこと。蹄、前脚、肩、顔、胴体、手、鎧、武器を素早く切り替え、馬の重量感と速度を表現する。顔や足のジェットカットは 0.2～0.6 秒、メインのアクションは 0.8～1.5 秒、最後の余韻ショットのみ 1.5～2 秒とする。背景を高速で流し、風圧、土煙、火花、髪、布の装飾でスピード感を高める。

[サウンド]
BGM は含めないこと。音楽、歌、ナレーションは一切禁止。効果音と環境音のみとする。重厚な蹄の音、地面の振動、鎧や金属装飾が触れ合う音、手綱の音、武器と槍がぶつかる短い金属音、矢を切る音、火の音、崩れる木材の音、旗の音、風、土煙、遠くの叫び声を強調する。

[ネガティブ]
テキスト、字幕、ロゴ、透かし、実在の家紋、ブランド、UI、画面分割、コラージュ、参照画像そのもの、単色背景上のキャラクターシートは禁止。主人公の人数を増やさないこと。別の人物を主人公にしないこと。性別、顔、髪型、髪色、年齢、鎧、配色、布の装飾、武器、画風を途中で変更しないこと。武器の消失、変形、複製、切り替わりは禁止。馬と騎手の融合や複製、異常な足の数、不自然な巨大ジャンプは避けること。遠距離からの固定視点、単調な横移動、長い直線の走行、静かな出陣、長いスローモーション、静止ポーズ、過度なファンタジー、光る武器、機械的な鎧、巨大な火の演出、画面が暗すぎるもの、コントラストが低いもの、濁った煙、火や煙に埋もれたキャラクターは避けること。

[条件定义]
约 15 秒，电影级高精度历史动作短片。以参考图像中的人物作为唯一角色锚点，保持性别、面部特征、眼神印象、发型、发色、年龄感、盔甲结构、配色方案、布料装饰和武器，确保其为同一人。若参考图像为真人实拍，则呈现为高质量真人实拍效果；若为动漫/插画，则在保持原有线条、配色和纹理的前提下呈现为高质量动漫画面，中途不得改变艺术风格。请勿继承参考图像的纯色背景、站姿、待机姿势或构图。

场景设定为黎明前夕即将陷落的日本城堡。从燃烧的城门中，参考图像中的骑马武士带领一小队骑兵发起最后冲锋。主角始终是参考图像中的那个人。小队骑兵为辅助存在，仅在主角身后或周围短暂出现。

[可选表演者外观]
一位勇敢而优雅的武士，传达出视死如归的决心。面部不要被烟雾或头发遮挡过多，确保即使在骑行过程中也能被识别为同一人。中途不得更换盔甲、布料装饰或武器。

[镜头/流程]
0.0–3.5s：从崩塌的城门出发。低位拉镜头展示燃烧的城门、碎裂的木门、烟雾、火星和破损的旗帜；骑马武士在木结构坍塌后立即冲出。使用快速剪辑（Jet cuts）持续展示眼睛、头发、紧握缰绳的手、武器柄、摇曳的盔甲和布料，以及马蹄踏地的瞬间。

3.5–8.0s：高速加速与箭雨。从超低位后侧对角线位置追踪马蹄和前腿，强调尘土飞扬。面部特写，展现即使在剧烈震动下依然锐利专注的表情。切换至高速侧向追踪，展示城墙、火焰、旗帜和敌军士兵快速掠过。箭矢从上方和前方如雨点般落下，武士低头闪避。摄像机从前对角线迅速移动至侧面，呈现立体冲锋感。

8.0–12.5s：冲击并突破敌方前线。前方长矛和盾牌林立。从低位前方视角，武士与马匹向镜头冲来，在撞击前瞬间拉开。武士不停顿，转向冲入长矛间隙，用武器击打敌方长矛一次，迸发出短暂的金属火花。在马蹄、眼睛、缰绳、武器与长矛接触点、盔甲、马肩和尘土之间快速切换，在保持速度的同时突破防线。

12.5–15.0s：余韵，速度不减。从尘土中冲出，继续向被朝阳照亮的战场奔去。身后是燃烧的城堡、倒塌的城门、混乱的敌阵和破损的旗帜。前方是金色的朝阳。武士没有停下，在奔跑中短暂回头或直视前方。最后，摄像机向上并向后拉远，将主角、小队骑兵、燃烧的城堡和黎明战场收入同一画面。不要明确结局是成功还是死亡，以一种余韵悠长的勇敢与悲壮感结束。

[摄像/剪辑]

0-2s：男主角坐在书桌前，低头专心看一本古书，眉头微皱。听到门外脚步声，他受惊般迅速合上书，眼神闪躲，耳朵微红，差点打翻茶杯。镜头缓慢推向他的脸部。背景为轻柔的古风弦乐，书合上时伴随一声短促的拨弦音。

4-6.5s：男主角起身，心虚地将书藏在身后。他试图保持镇定但明显慌乱，结巴道：“不是你想的那样，我只是……在研究房事。”语调紧张尴尬。女主角脸更红了，眼神从震惊转为恼怒。音乐暂停，伴随轻微的喜剧滑音。

6.5-8.5s：女主角快步走到书桌前，假装平静实则恼火地抢过书。他想阻拦却犹豫不决，显得无奈又委屈。她压低声音，带着富家小姐的威严说道：“你还敢藏？”镜头跟随书的移动，前景有模糊的烛光。

prompt:
A muddy dirt track through thick green rainforest in grey daylight. An army supply convoy of trucks drives along the narrow track, jungle pressing in on both sides. A giant python, thick as a bus with dark green scales, has wrapped around the last truck and is dragging it backward into the trees. At the front, a gunner stands at a mounted gun on the lead gun-truck. Sound: roaring engines, groaning metal, soldiers shouting, snake hissing, rifle fire, radio voices.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low rear shot in the mud. The giant python squeezes the last truck and hauls it backward off the track into the trees, wheels sliding in the mud. Soldiers on the truck fire their rifles into the thick coils, but the bullets do nothing. The rear driver wrestles his wheel and shouts into his radio: “IT’S PULLING ME INTO THE TREES!”

Shot 2 (3–6s): At the front of the convoy. The gunner swings his mounted gun around to point back down the line, but holds his fire — the snake is wrapped on the truck with men still on it. He calls on the radio: “Cut your trailer! Get it on the track!”

Shot 3 (6–9s): At the rear truck. The driver pulls the trailer release. The truck breaks free and lurches forward onto the track — and the python, still wrapped around the heavy trailer, is yanked out of the trees with it, spilling onto the open muddy track, rearing its head up in the clear.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The snake is out in the open on the track now. The lead gunner opens fire. Bullet time — a long stream of heavy rounds flies down the line in slow motion, smoke and shell cases hanging in the air, tearing into the coiled python, mud and broken branches bursting up around it.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The python drops and lies still across the muddy track beside the wrecked trailer, smoke rising off it. The freed rear truck pulls up the line to the others, soldiers climbing down into the mud. Smoke drifts through the trees. Cut.

prompt:

Opening frame: the camera glides down a silent boulevard between towering buildings covered in text. The ink moves slightly, as if breathing.

At the 2-second mark, one word detaches from a wall.

It floats into the air and becomes a cloud.

Then thousands of words peel away from buildings, rising into the sky. Some become rain, some become birds, some become lightning, some become black snow. Sentences unravel into long ribbon storms that whip through the streets.

The camera follows a single phrase as it transforms into a tornado of letters, pulling street signs, papers, and window reflections into its spiral.

VFX escalation: the weather becomes linguistic. Rain falls as tiny punctuation marks. Thunder appears as giant words flashing across the sky. Fog forms from erased sentences.

Velocity ramp: a lightning bolt made of handwritten text strikes the street , individual letters suspended in mid-impact, glowing white against the monochrome city.

Final moment: all text vanishes from the buildings, leaving the city completely blank. A single new word appears on the ground beneath the camera: REMEMBER.

Experimental typographic surrealism, monochrome art-film aesthetic, ink particle simulation, atmospheric word-weather VFX, cinematic minimalism, 4K.

prompt:
参照画像のキャラクターを主人公として使用してください。15 秒、24 fps。日本のアニメ調フルカラー。劇場版アニメのような高品質なアニメーションスタイル。高フレームレート。可愛さを強調し、バイラル（拡散）を狙った短いダンス動画。主人公は参照画像のキャラクターそのものです。参照画像の髪型、髪色、目、顔立ち、体格、年齢、服装の印象、アクセサリー、全体的な雰囲気を維持してください。背景は明るくキュートで、整理された教室やスタジオのような空間。人物が主役になるよう背景はシンプルにしつつ、ポップでフレッシュな雰囲気にしてください。

音楽：日本の楽曲。既存の実際の楽曲は使用しないでください。

ビジュアルコンセプト：主人公が可愛いダンスを披露します。可愛さを最優先。少し小悪魔的でフレンドリー、カメラに向かって踊っていることを強く意識した演出。After Effects で制作したような 2D フラットアニメーションが、ダンスの動きに合わせて表示されます。エフェクトはクレヨンやオイルパステルのような質感の手描きイラスト。丸、星、ハート、花、音符、矢印、リボン、王冠、キラキラ、波線、渦巻き線、吹き出し枠、チェック柄、斜線、ハーフトーンなど。すべてフラットな 2D アニメーションです。カラーパレットはピンク、水色、黄色、白、ラベンダー、ミントグリーンを中心に、キャラクターの色と調和させてください。

カメラ構成：5 台のカメラ設定。カメラは固定せず、2 秒ごとに切り替わります。使用カメラ：正面、上部（ハイアングル）、左、右、背面。カメラアングルに関わらず、主人公は常にレンズを意識し、アイコンタクトを維持します。正面以外の角度でも、顔を向けたり視線を送ったりしてレンズを見つめます。背面カメラでは、肩越しにレンズを覗き込みます。アングルが多様でテンポが良く、バイラルに適したカメラワーク。カメラは静止せず、ビートに合わせて軽く揺れ、小さな上下のバウンド、短いパンチイン、わずかな左右の揺れを加えます。意図的でクリーンなカメラシェイクであり、乱雑なものではありません。

ダンスの内容：可愛くて真似しやすいダンス。軽いサイドステップ、胸の前でハンドハート、片手ハート、頬でピースサイン、頬の横で手を開く、指差し、小さな肩のバウンド、軽い腰の揺れ、足を前後に出す動き、小さなターン、最後にウィンク。短時間でインパクトを与えるため、上半身の動きに集中してください。視聴者に直接踊りかけているかのように、常にアイコンタクトを維持してください。

15 秒のタイムライン：
0.0-2.0 秒：正面カメラ。主人公が中央でリズムを取り、サイドステップを踏みながら胸の前でハンドハート。軽い縦のカメラバウンド。手や顔の周りにクレヨン風のハート、星、丸が表示される。正面へのアイコンタクト。
2.0-4.0 秒：上部カメラ。少しハイアングルの可愛いショット。頬でピースサイン、片手ハート、指差しをしてレンズを見上げる。顔の周りに王冠、花、吹き出し枠が表示される。
4.0-6.0 秒：左カメラ。体は少し左を向いているが、顔と視線はレンズへ。腰の揺れ、片手を頬に添え、もう片方の手で手を振る。手の動きに合わせてクレヨン風のリボン線、音符、星が追従する。軽いサイドのカメラ揺れ。
6.0-8.0 秒：右カメラ。体は右を向いているが、アイコンタクトを維持。リズミカルな肩のバウンド、腕の動き、足のステップ。足元や肩の周りに花、丸、ハーフトーンが弾ける。ビートに合わせた短いパンチイン。
8.0-10.0 秒：背面カメラ。後ろ向きから始まり、回転して肩越しにレンズを見つめる。指差しとフィンガーハート、または投げキッスを交えた小さなターン。髪や服の周りに渦巻き線や星が表示される。
10.0-12.0 秒：正面カメラに戻る。ハイエネルギーセクション。腕を大きく広げ、小さくバウンド。可愛さを最大化するために、より大きなハート、星、花が増える。動きに合わせて短いカメラシェイク。
12.0-14.0 秒：上部カメラに戻る。見上げながら、顔の横で手を開き、片手ハート。背景に枠、ハート、花が広がる。継続的なアイコンタクト。
14.0-15.0 秒：正面ヒーローショット。バストアップのクローズアップ。笑顔で最後にウィンク。目からクレヨン風の十字星、ハート、リボンが弾ける。短いパンチインで、最後のバイラルカットで停止。

AE スタイル 2D アニメーション演出：すべてのアフェクトは After Effects で制作したようなフラットな 2D アニメーションですが、ラフな手描きクレヨン/パステルの質感を持ちます。動きには出現、バウンド、拡大縮小、回転、フェードを含みます。エフェクトは顔を隠さないように、手、顔、足、体の動きと同期させてください。

制約事項：主人公以外の人物は登場させないこと。参照画像からキャラクターの一貫性（顔、髪、目、年齢、服装）を維持すること。キャラクターや衣装を変更しないこと。2 秒ごとに切り替わる 5 台のカメラ構成を使用すること。常にアイコンタクトを維持すること。クレヨン手描き風のエフェクトのみを使用すること。リアルな炎、煙、過度なグリッチは禁止。テキスト、字幕、ロゴは含めないこと。

[00:00-00:04] Shot 1: The Hover (Telephoto close-up, 600mm)
Super-telephoto close-up: an osprey hangs almost motionless in the air, wings beating in tight powerful strokes, head locked dead-still and angled straight down. Every feather barb is razor-sharp — chocolate-brown back, snow-white underparts trembling in its own downdraft. In the pale-yellow iris the pupil snaps to a pinpoint as it fixes on a trout finning just beneath the surface. Tiny beads of mist cling to the leading edges of the wings.

Side-tracking high-speed shot: the osprey folds its wings and drops like a thrown spear, body stretched into a single straight line, talons swung forward and wide, dawn light sliding along the wet curve of the beak. Slow motion captures the instant of impact — the bird punches through the mirror surface and a crown of water bursts outward in a perfect ring, individual droplets hanging suspended in the air, each one catching the light like a glass bead. A translucent nictitating membrane sweeps across the eye a split second before contact.
[00:07-00:10] Shot 3: The Strike (Extreme close-up, macro lens)
Extreme macro close-up: the moment the talons close on the trout — scaled yellow toes spreading apart, black hooked claws sinking through flashing silver fish-scales, a thin sheet of water peeling off the feathers. Shallow depth of field blurs the spray streaking past the lens. Freeze-frame on a single droplet rolling off the tip of a claw, the fish's gill flaring open, cold light glinting on the soaked, curved talon.

敵は生物ではなく、黒曜石と金属で構成された無人の魔法兵です。黒い多面体の装甲、角のような突起、そして青く光る魔法の核を持っています。内部は石、歯車、青い光のみで構成されています。

兵士たちは道路、車両の周囲、路地裏、壁、高架線路などに不規則に配置されています。サイズ、向き、距離、姿勢はそれぞれわずかに異なり、等間隔や対称には配置されていません。それぞれが異なる速度とタイミングで、走る、跳躍する、ジグザグに動く、壁を伝う、あるいは立ち止まって狙いを定めるなどの動きを見せます。

ショット 1 (0～4秒):
雨の交差点。手前左側に Lyra がおり、中景から背景の右側にかけて魔法兵が自然に散らばっています。カメラは水たまりの反射越しに Lyra に接近し、彼女の横を通り過ぎながら、街中で個別に起動する兵士たちを映し出します。青い魔法の核が不規則な順序で点灯します。

ショット 2 (4～10秒):
Lyra が加速し、水しぶきを上げます。カメラは彼女と並行して低位置を移動します。Lyra の剣が兵士の装甲を切り裂くと、その軌跡に沿って黒曜石の殻に青い亀裂が走ります。次の瞬間、兵士は幾何学的な石の破片と金属パーツに砕け散り、内部の青い魔法は光の粒子となって空へと消えていきます。

Lyra は突進してくる脚型の敵を粉砕し、ジグザグに動く敵を横薙ぎの一撃で粉砕します。車から飛び出してきた 2 体の間を転がりながら立ち上がり、淡い青色の斬撃を放ちます。壁から降りてきた敵を空中回転斬りで破壊します。砕けた黒曜石の破片が雨水を跳ね上げながら道路を滑っていきます。

ショット 3 (10～15秒):
多数の魔法兵が Lyra に迫ります。前方の 3 体が剣の間合いで腕を上げ、中景の個体が側面から接近し、遠方の大型個体が突進してきます。Lyra と接近する敵を常に同じフレーム内に収めてください。

Lyra は鞘のない剣を右手に低く構えます。刀身に淡い青色の光が集中します。前方の 3 体が攻撃を仕掛ける直前、Lyra は腰を回転させ、180 度の巨大な扇状の衝撃波を放ちます。

ワイドなサイドショットで、Lyra、剣、前方の敵、そして衝撃波を同時に捉えます。衝撃波は前方から後方へと進み、黒曜石の装甲に青い亀裂を刻みます。一瞬の遅れを経て、手前から奥へと連鎖的に砕け散ります。何百もの黒曜石の破片、金属パーツ、青い光の粒子が雨の交差点を覆い、ネオンの街灯を反射します。

最後の大型個体が巨大な石の塊となって崩れ落ちると、青い魔法の核が静かに消えます。交差点には Lyra だけが立ち、剣を下ろして息を吐きます。砕けた黒曜石の破片に雨が打ち付け、彼女の白いドレスがゆっくりと落ち着きます。

重要事項:
敵は無人の石と金属の構造体であるという一貫性を保ってください。破壊された際は、黒曜石の破片、金属パーツ、青い光の粒子のみを描画してください。柔らかい肉体の表現や有機的な内部構造は描かないでください。

最後の巨大な斬撃は、複数の敵が接近し、攻撃モーションに入った瞬間に放たれる必要があります。敵が消えた後や、誰もいない道路に向かって斬撃を放たないでください。

The whole thing is shot in a quiet Korean residential neighborhood — narrow concrete alleys, low-rise houses with small terraces, a front yard with a clothesline, potted plants, parked bicycles and motorcycles, big trees, and overhead cables everywhere. No shops, no vendors, nothing commercial. Just a real neighborhood.

Camera treatment is the whole point. This needs to look like someone's friend grabbed a DV camcorder and just started recording — no plan, no setup, no nothing. Heavy handheld shake, constant reframing, subject drifting toward the edges, autofocus hunting, lens breathing, exposure pumping. This aesthetic is non-negotiable.

She starts sitting on a concrete sidewalk fixing her ponytail, arms raised, genuine smile, wind catching her hair — camera barely holding focus. Then the camera follows her into a narrow alley where she crouches down and feeds a stray cat that comes right up to her. After that she's in her front yard hanging laundry on the clothesline, morning breeze moving everything, camera swaying and hunting. Mid-section she's on the front terrace with a coffee cup, just sitting quietly, looking out at the street — loose drifting shot from the side. Then a right-side close shot where she raises her arm, waves warmly toward someone off-frame and says "Annyeong" — camera catches it a beat late. Final shot is a slow tracking walk down the street, coffee cup in hand, she notices the lens, turns slightly and gives a real quiet smile — then the recording just cuts to black mid-motion like the camcorder got switched off.

0.0～1.3 秒 | 即時開始
広告背景の極端なクローズアップ。厚みのあるオレンジとネイビーのペイントが上昇し、多方向に弾け飛ぶ。カメラは表面のすぐ上を高速で滑走する。

prompt:
1. CREATION BRIEF

Generate an original 15-second dark-fantasy cinematic sequence in vertical 9:16 aspect ratio at 720p resolution. The video is a single sustained spectacle of a colossal pale bone-white frost dragon attacking a frozen mountain stronghold carved into a glacier cliff. The dragon is the unambiguous protagonist of every frame: it bursts up through a frozen lake in an explosion of shattered ice, climbs a sheer ice-clad fortress wall ripping through hanging defensive chains and frozen ballista nests, exhales a torrent of freezing breath that flash-rimes a watchtower into a brittle crystal husk, then slams its tail through that frozen tower so it shatters into glittering shards, before the camera pulls back to reveal a vast high-angle panorama of the glacial citadel cracking apart under a green aurora sky. The mood is cold, awe-inspiring, merciless, otherworldly. Pale aurora light battles deep arctic blue gloom throughout. Dense ice-fog and snow-spray roll across the frame, scattering aurora light into shimmering veils. Scale must read MASSIVE — the dragon is many times larger than any human, who appear as tiny dark fur-wrapped figures on the walls. Pacing is fast and kinetic with hard cuts on impacts, settling into a stabilized epic final reveal. Photoreal CGI, no stylization, no cartoon look. Every motion obeys heavy gravity and inertia.

2. STYLE BIBLE

Medium: realistic high-budget feature-film CGI, photoreal rendering, ray-traced lighting, physically based shading, subsurface scattering on ice and snow. Zero illustration or anime stylization, zero painterly look. Lens language: cinematic full-frame virtual cinematography, focal lengths roughly 24–50mm; wide anamorphic-feeling framing for the lake burst and climb beats, slightly longer for the breath and tail beats; shallow-to-medium depth of field with atmospheric ice-fog providing natural depth falloff and visible particulate. Color palette: a desaturated cold base of glacier blue, steel cyan, frost white, slate grey, deep teal shadow — punctuated by ethereal aurora greens and faint violets dancing overhead, with cold blue-white glow from the dragon's breath and occasional warm flickers of dying torchlight on the fortress walls (1900K) reading almost amber against the all-blue world. Lighting setup: key from a broad aurora-lit night sky (cool, roughly 7500–9000K, with animated green ribbon glow), strong cyan rim from glacier surfaces, bounce fill from snow, faint warm torch fill from defenders, brilliant cold pulse during the freeze-breath, harsh momentary highlights of refracted light when ice shatters. Texture/material rules: dragon hide is matte bone-white to pale-blue scale, dry and powdery with a frost dusting on the back plates, layered overlapping armored scutes along the spine; horns and head-crest are translucent bluish ice-crystal, internally refracting aurora light; wing membranes are pale milky leather, semi-translucent at thin edges with visible frozen vein structure backlit by the sky; thin rime crystals cling to the jaw and brow ridges and shed when it moves. Environment: glassy blue glacier ice with internal fracture lines and trapped bubbles, carved grey granite battlements, iron chains crusted with frost, frozen rope and timber ballistae, snow banks and wind-driven spindrift. Motion style: weighty deliberate wingbeats, explosive bursts on impacts, persistent realistic motion blur on fast pans, fine procedural snow-spray and ice-shard simulation, vapor of freezing breath rolling with believable turbulence.

3. CHARACTER / SUBJECT BIBLE

DRAGON — Silhouette: gigantic quadrupedal winged reptile distinct from any other beast — leaner and more serpentine than a bull-built dragon, a long sinuous neck, narrow angular skull crowned with a swept-back fan of translucent ice-crystal horns, a slim deep chest, long sail-finned tail, broad bat-like wings with frost-feathered trailing edges. Proportions: head narrow and elongated like a frozen wolf-skull, jaw long and lined with glassy teeth, legs long and lean with broad splayed clawed feet built to grip ice, talons clear and sharp like quartz. A continuous low crest of crystalline spines runs from the back of the skull down the neck and spine, longest at the shoulders, fanning into a thin translucent sail along the tail. Material/skin: matte bone-white to pale-blue scales with a permanent frost dusting, overlapping armored plating along the back, softer pebbled hide on throat and belly tinted faint cyan, dry surface catching aurora light as soft cold sheen rather than wet gloss. Wing membranes milky pale leather, fingered with long ice-rimed bony struts, edges glowing translucent blue when backlit by the sky. Eyes: pale ice-blue, slit-pupiled, glowing faintly from within, with minimal expressive range — base reptilian blinks and pupil tracking only; no humanlike emotion. Facial range: jaw opens and closes, nostrils vent visible cold vapor, lips peel slightly to show glassy teeth during exertion. Body language: serpentine, predatory, fluid in flight, explosive in attack; wings beat with deep deliberate downstrokes that visibly compress air and fling snow. Weight & balance: body reads as tons of mass — every landing compresses ice and cracks it, every wingbeat strains, tail counterbalances turns, neck leads movement. Contact points: talons grip and gouge ice, shoulders and tail-sail shatter chains and frozen timber, the tail-sweep demolishes the watchtower.

HUMANS — mountain defenders in heavy fur cloaks, frost-rimed mail, leather, and pale wool, rendered small and low-detail due to scale, appearing as dark scrambling silhouettes, falling bodies, and tumbling figures along the walls. No facial detail required; they exist to convey scale and chaos.

4. ENVIRONMENT / PROPS

Spatial layout: a fortress citadel carved into and atop a towering glacier cliff at night, with a frozen lake spreading at its base, terraced granite battlements, hanging iron chains strung with frozen warning bells, ballista nests built of frost-cracked timber, and a tall slender watchtower of stacked stone and ice rising above the walls. Background depth: receding glacier ridges and snow peaks into ice-fog distance, an aurora-banded night sky on the horizon. Surfaces: glassy fracture-veined ice, frost-crusted granite, iron chains, frozen rope, snow drifts, spindrift sheets blown across the frame. Props: hanging chains and frozen bells, frozen ballistae and bolts, defensive banners stiff with ice, snow-laden timber, loose ice blocks and rubble. Scale reference: the watchtower stands several stories tall yet is dwarfed by the dragon; defenders are ant-sized beside the beast. Physical constraints: ice shatters into glittering refractive shards and fine crystalline dust on impact, chains snap and whip with stored tension, granite fractures into rigid chunks raising frost-haze, frozen banners crack and crumble, freeze-breath rimes surfaces white and makes them brittle, gravity pulls all debris and bodies convincingly downward with arcing trajectories.

5. TIMECODED SHOT PLAN

00:00–00:04 — BURST FROM THE FROZEN LAKE. Frame: vertical composition, the frozen lake surface fills the lower two-thirds, the glacier fortress looming above against the aurora. Setup: a half-second of still cracked ice, hairline fractures spidering across the surface. Impact: the dragon's narrow skull and crystal horns erupt upward through the ice in a violent explosion of shattered plates and water-spray, neck driving skyward, frost crystals raining. Force/weight: tons of mass surging up, displaced ice slabs flung and arcing, spray sheeting outward. Facial: ice-blue eye snapping open, vapor venting from nostrils. Camera: low water-level angle looking up, sharp upward tilt following the rising skull, strong shake on the burst that decays in half a second. 1. 创作简报

生成一段 15 秒的原创黑暗奇幻电影序列，采用 9:16 竖屏比例，分辨率为 720p。视频是一个持续的壮观场面：一头巨大的苍白骨白色冰霜巨龙正在袭击一座雕刻在冰川悬崖上的冰封山地要塞。巨龙是每一帧中毋庸置疑的主角：它从冰封的湖面破冰而出，伴随着破碎冰块的爆炸声；它攀爬在陡峭的冰封堡垒墙壁上，扯断悬挂的防御铁链，摧毁冰冻的弩炮阵地；它呼出一股极寒气息，将一座瞭望塔瞬间冻结成脆弱的晶体外壳，随后用尾巴猛击那座冰塔，使其碎裂成闪烁的碎片。最后，摄像机拉远，展现出在绿色极光天空下，冰川城堡正在崩裂的宏大广角全景。氛围冷冽、令人敬畏、冷酷且超凡脱俗。苍白的极光与深邃的北极蓝色幽暗在画面中交织。浓重的冰雾和雪沫在画面中翻滚，将极光散射成闪烁的帷幕。尺度感必须体现“巨大”——巨龙比任何人类都要大得多，人类在墙上看起来只是微小的深色毛皮包裹的身影。节奏快速且充满动感，撞击处采用硬剪辑，最终定格在稳定的史诗级画面。写实 CGI，无风格化，无卡通感。每一个动作都遵循沉重的重力和惯性。

2. 风格指南

prompt:
コンセプト：カメラは一瞬たりとも停止しません。最高速度かつ最小振幅で常に細かく動き続けるダンサーを捉えます。
基本リズムは 16 分音符（1 拍を 4 分割）以上の高密度で、各インターバルでカメラはフリック、ティック、ズームイン、またはズームアウトのいずれかを行う必要があります。静止フレームは作成しないでください。キーポーズの間であっても、カメラは高周波の微振動を続け、構図を維持します。停止しているように見えても、実際には小さな刻みで脈動し続けています。緩慢な中速の動きは禁止です。動きには常に鋭いスナップモーションの始点と終点があり、その間に遅い補間を挟まないでください。
常に実行すべきマイクロモーション（最速、小振幅、高周波）：
連続マイクロズーム（各インターバルで数％のズームイン／アウトを高速で往復し、絶え間なく脈動させる）
ビートバウンス（足踏みや膝の屈伸に合わせてカメラが上下に小さく跳ね続ける）
ジッターパン（肩のヒットや首の動きに合わせて左右に鋭く小さく振る）
マイクロシェイク（強い拍で数ピクセル分鋭く揺らし、すぐに次のインターバルへ移行）
高速リフレーミング（16 分音符ごとに構図を微調整し、ペアを常に最適な位置に収める）
マイクロオービット振動（中心軸を中心に左右へ小角度で揺れ続ける）
身体部位ごとの瞬間同期（鋭く高速に）：
肩のヒット -> カメラが逆方向にスナップ
指先／腕のライン -> 軌道に合わせてズームが高速追従
首振り／髪の揺れ -> カメラも同じ方向に鋭く振り、即座に戻る
ウエストウェーブ／ボディロール -> カメラが垂直方向に小さく波打つ
スポットターン -> カメラが逆回転で小さく円を描く
大規模な「投射」モーション（重要な瞬間に最高速度で展開するが、展開後も微振動は停止しない）：
スナップズーム（最高速度で瞬時に目的地に到達し、到達後もマイクロズームを継続）
ウィップパン（最高速度で両者の間を振り、ピークで微振動ホールドへ移行）
急降下／急上昇クレーンショット
高速 360 度オービット
ドリーズーム（背景の伸縮、ワンショット）
床レベルのローアングルから急上昇
ダッチアングル（重要な瞬間に大胆に傾け、傾いたまま微振動）

リズムの原則：
全体を通して：カメラは 1 フレームも停止せず、最速かつ最小振幅で刻み続けます。
強い拍：マイクロモーションの上に大きな動きを重ねます（刻みは止めない）。
キーポーズ：完全な静止ではなく「微振動ホールド」を行います。構図は固定されますが、カメラは小さな刻みで生き続けます。
彼らが回転すればカメラは逆回転し、ジャンプには跳躍で応じ、前進には後退で、すべてに最高速度で反応します。
ハードカットではなく、ライブ番組のような流れるような切り替えでつなぎます。

[15 秒の構成]
0.0～2.0 秒：天井付近の超広角から、最初の拍でクレーンダイブ＋スナップズームを最高速度で展開し、バストアップのツーショットへ。着地と同時にマイクロズームとビートバウンスが脈動を開始し、決して止まりません。両者が同時に肩、頭、腰をアイソレーションし、ヒットごとにカメラが前後へスナップします。カメラへの微笑みさえも微振動ホールドで捉えます。
2.0～4.0 秒：16 分音符でマイクロズームを脈動させながら、中心軸の半分を高速で旋回。サイドステップ／片手ハート／胸元ハート／指差し（鏡合わせの振り付け）を行い、ステップごとに上下にバウンス。ピークで止めず、微振動ホールドへ移行して髪の残像を捉えます。
4.0～6.0 秒：床レベルのローアングルショット。ボディロールやウエストウェーブに合わせてカメラが垂直に波打ちます。肩のヒットごとに左右へジッターパン。足元から急上昇するクレーンアップ。顎を上げた笑顔も微振動ホールド＋ダッチアングル（傾きながら振動）で捉えます。
6.0～8.0 秒：1 人へスナップズーム -> 入れ替わりでウィップパン。ズーム後もマイクロシェイクを鋭く継続。リップシンク、頬に手を当てる／片手ハート／首を傾げる。指先に合わせてズームが高速追従。ピークの表情は微振動ホールドで。
8.0～10.0 秒：両者が高速スポットターン（対称）を行う間、1 回の高速 360 度オービット。カメラは小さな刻みで逆回転し、停止せずにマイクロオービット振動へ移行。片手ハートを合わせて大きなハートを作る瞬間、最小振幅でマイクロズームを脈動させます。
10.0～12.0 秒（サビ）：ワイドショットへ高速パンチアウト。ステージ全体を使った大きなデュエットダンス。斜めの動き -> 中央への集合、すべてのステップでビートバウンスを同期。彼らの跳躍に合わせてカメラもジャンプ。腕の大きなラインに合わせ、ズームが軌道を追従。サビの開始時にドリーズームを 1 回、拡大中もマイクロシェイクを継続。
12.0～14.0 秒：高速パンチアウトとパンチインを繰り返し、距離を素早く変化させます。彼らが顔を近づけても、カメラは 16 分音符でズームイン／アウトを繰り返します。アイコンタクト／レンズへの指差し、指に合わせてカメラが小さくズーム追従。柔らかな笑顔を微振動ホールドで捉えます。
14.0～15.0 秒（キリングパート）：彼らが踏み込んで寄り添う瞬間、最高速度のスナップズーム＋ウィップでクローズアップのツーショットへ。到達時に完全に停止せず、最高周波数／最小振幅の微振動ホールドで締めくくり、ポーズ、笑顔、同期したウィンクを披露します。止まっているように見えて、生きているフィニッシュ。

variants.text:
概念：相机绝不停歇。舞者以最高速度和最小幅度不断进行细微移动。
基本节奏为高密度的 16 分音符（1 拍分为 4 份）或更高，在每个间隔，相机必须执行以下动作之一：轻弹、点动、放大或缩小。不要创建静态画面。即使在关键姿势期间，相机也要保持高频微震动以维持构图；即使看起来静止，实际上也在以微小增量脉动。拒绝缓慢的中间过渡。动作始终具有尖锐的起始和结束点，中间没有缓慢的插值。
全程运行的微动作（最快速度、小幅度、高频率）：
连续微缩放（在每个间隔以几个百分点的幅度快速往复缩放，持续脉动）
节拍弹跳（相机随脚步/膝盖起伏同步进行小幅上下弹跳）
抖动平移（随肩部撞击/头部晃动进行小幅尖锐的左右平移）
微震动（在强拍上进行几个像素的尖锐晃动，并立即进入下一个间隔）
高速重构图（每 16 分音符持续微调构图，使双人保持在最佳位置）
微轨道振荡（绕中心轴进行连续小角度左右摇摆）
各身体部位的瞬时同步（尖锐且快速）：
肩部撞击 -> 相机向相反方向猛冲
指尖/手臂线条 -> 缩放随轨迹高速移动
头部晃动/头发飘动 -> 相机也向同一方向剧烈摆动并立即返回
腰部波浪/身体律动 -> 相机垂直方向微小起伏
定点旋转 -> 相机以反向旋转进行微小圆周运动
大规模“投射”动作（在关键时刻以最高速度部署，部署后微震动不停）：
快照缩放（以最高速度瞬间到达目的地，到达后继续微缩放）
鞭式平移（在两者之间以最高速度摆动，在顶点过渡到微震动保持）
快速摇臂下降/摇臂上升
高速 360 度轨道环绕
滑动变焦（背景扩张/收缩，一镜到底）
地面低角度到快速上升
荷兰式倾斜（在关键时刻大胆倾斜，倾斜时保持微震动）

节奏原则：
全程：相机不停止任何一帧，以最快速度和最小幅度点动。
强拍：在微动作之上叠加大幅度动作（不要停止点动）。
关键姿势：并非完全静止，而是“微震动保持”。构图固定，但相机以微小增量保持活力。
如果他们旋转，相机反向旋转；他们跳跃时相机随之跳动，他们前进时相机后退，对一切动作做出最高速度反应。
用流畅的直播式切换连接一切，而非硬切。

[15 秒构图]
0.0–2.0s：从天花板附近的超广角镜头开始，在第一拍以最高速度部署摇臂下降 + 快照缩放，落入半身双人镜头。落地同时，微缩放和节拍弹跳开始脉动且永不停歇。两人同时进行肩部、头部和腰部隔离动作；每次撞击，相机都来回猛冲。即使是对着镜头微笑，也以微震动保持捕捉。
2.0–4.0s：以高速绕中心轴旋转半圈，同时连续微缩放以 16 分音符脉动。并排踏步 / 单手比心 / 胸前比心 / 指向（镜像编舞），随每一步上下弹跳。在顶点不要停止；过渡到微震动保持以捕捉头发残影。
4.0–6.0s：地面低角度镜头。相机随身体律动/腰部波浪垂直起伏。每有一次肩部撞击就进行左右抖动平移。从脚部开始快速摇臂上升。仰头微笑也以微震动保持 + 荷兰式倾斜（倾斜时震动）捕捉。
6.0–8.0s：快照缩放至一人 -> 鞭式平移切换至另一人。缩放后微震动依然尖锐。口型同步、脸颊比心 / 单手比心 / 歪头。缩放随指尖高速移动。表情顶点处进行微震动保持。
8.0–10.0s：进行一次完整的高速 360 度轨道环绕，同时两人进行高速定点旋转（对称）。相机以微小增量反向旋转，无缝过渡到微轨道振荡。两人单手比心拼成一个大心形，此时以最小幅度脉动微缩放。
10.0–12.0s（副歌）：快速推远至广角。舞台上进行大型双人舞。对角线移动 -> 中心汇聚，所有脚步与节拍弹跳同步。相机随他们的跳跃而跳动。大幅度手臂线条同步，缩放随路径移动。副歌开始时进行一次滑动变焦，扩张期间微震动持续。
12.0–14.0s：重复快速推远和推近以快速改变距离。即使他们靠近，相机也以 16 分音符进行推拉。眼神接触 / 手指指向镜头，缩放随手指微小增量移动。柔和的微笑以微震动保持捕捉。
14.0–15.0s（高潮部分）：当他们靠近并倚靠在一起时，最高速度的快照缩放 + 鞭式平移切入特写双人镜头。到达后不要完全停止；以最高频率/最小幅度的微震动保持结束，展示姿势、微笑和同步眨眼。一个看起来静止但充满活力的结尾。

variants.text:
Concept: The camera never stops for a second. Another dancer who constantly moves in small increments at the highest speed and minimum amplitude.
The basic rhythm is a high density of 16th notes (1 beat divided into 4) or more, and at each interval, the camera must perform one of the following: flick, tick, zoom in, or zoom out. Do not create static frames. Even during key poses, the camera continues high-frequency micro-vibrations, maintaining the composition; even if it appears to stop, it is actually pulsing in small increments. No lazy medium-speed movement. Movement always has sharp snap motion start and end points, with no slow interpolation in between.
Micro-motions to run constantly throughout (fastest, small amplitude, high frequency):
Continuous micro-zooms (fast round trips of zooming in/out by a few % at each interval, pulsing incessantly)
Beat bounce (camera keeps bouncing small up and down in sync with foot steps/knee dips)
Jitter pan (small sharp pans left and right in time with shoulder hits/head shakes)
Micro-shake (sharp shake of a few pixels on strong beats, immediately to the next interval)
High-speed reframing (continuously fine-tuning composition every 16th note to keep the pair in the best position)
Micro-orbit oscillation (continuous small-angle swaying left and right around the central axis)
Instantaneous synchronization per body part (sharp and fast):
Shoulder hit -> Camera snaps in the opposite direction
Fingertips/arm lines -> Zoom follows the trajectory at high speed
Head shake/hair flutter -> Camera also swings sharply in the same direction and immediately returns
Waist wave/body roll -> Camera undulates vertically in small increments
Spot turn -> Camera circles in small increments in reverse rotation
Large-scale 'projectiles' (deployed at top speed at key moments, but micro-vibrations do not stop after deployment):
Snap zoom (reaches destination instantly at top speed, continues micro-zooming after arrival)
Whip pan (swings between the two at top speed, transitions to micro-vibration hold at the peak)
Rapid crane dive/crane up
High-speed 360-degree orbit
Dolly zoom (background expansion/contraction, one-shot)
Floor-level low angle to rapid ascent
Dutch angle (bold tilt at key moments, micro-vibrating while tilted)

Rhythm Principles:
Throughout: The camera does not stop for a single frame, ticking at the fastest speed and minimum amplitude.
Strong beats: Layer large movements over micro-motions (do not stop ticking).
Key poses: Not complete stillness, but a 'micro-vibration hold'. Composition is fixed, but the camera lives on in small increments.
If they turn, the camera reverses; it leaps for jumps, retreats when they advance, reacting to everything at top speed.
Connect everything with flowing live-program-style switching rather than hard cuts.

[15-Second Composition]
0.0–2.0s: From an ultra-wide shot near the ceiling, deploy a crane dive + snap zoom at top speed on the first beat to drop into a bust-up two-shot. Simultaneously with landing, micro-zooms and beat bounces start pulsing and never stop. Both perform shoulder, head, and waist isolation simultaneously; at each hit, the camera snaps back and forth. Even a smile to the camera is captured with a micro-vibration hold.
2.0–4.0s: Orbit halfway around the central axis at high speed while continuous micro-zooms pulse at 16th notes. Side-by-side steps / one-handed hearts / chest-level hearts / finger pointing (mirrored choreography), bouncing up and down with each step. Do not stop at the peak; transition to a micro-vibration hold to capture hair afterimages.
4.0–6.0s: Low-angle floor-level shot. Camera undulates vertically for body rolls/waist waves. Jitter pan left and right for every shoulder hit. Rapid crane-up ascent from the feet. Smiling with chin up is also captured with a micro-vibration hold + Dutch angle (tilting while shaking).
6.0–8.0s: Snap zoom to one person -> whip pan for the exchange to the other. Micro-shakes continue sharply even after zooming. Lip-sync, cheek piece / one-handed heart / head tilt. Zoom follows fingertips at high speed. Micro-vibration hold for expressions at the peak.
8.0–10.0s: One full high-speed 360-degree orbit while both perform high-speed spot turns (symmetrical). Camera circles in reverse in small increments, transitioning to micro-orbit oscillation without stopping. Meeting one-handed hearts to form one big heart, pulsing the micro-zoom at minimum amplitude at that moment.
10.0–12.0s (Chorus): Fast punch-out to wide shot. Large duet dance across the stage. Diagonal movement -> central gathering, beat bounce sync on all steps. Camera jumps in sync with their leap. Large arm lines in unison, zoom follows the path. One dolly zoom at the start of the chorus, micro-shaking continues during expansion.
12.0–14.0s: Repeated fast punch-outs and punch-ins to rapidly vary distance. Even as they lean in close, the camera ticks in and out at 16th notes. Eye contact / finger to lens, zoom follows the finger in small increments. Soft smiles captured with micro-vibration hold.
14.0–15.0s (Killing Part): As they step in and lean together, a top-speed snap zoom + whip pierces into a close-up two-shot. Do not stop completely upon arrival; finish with a micro-vibration hold at the highest frequency/minimum amplitude to showcase poses, smiles, and synchronized winks. A finish that appears stopped but is alive.

Storybook illustrated wide shot of a tiny golden town at sunrise. Cobblestone streets, pastel shop fronts, flowers in window boxes. Soft watercolor sky in peach and lavender. A warm narrator title card fades in like a book page turning. Camera gently pushes forward. No characters yet — just the world breathing awake. Painterly, soft, magical. Children's picture book aesthetic.

Illustrated medium shot. Two heroic girls stroll into frame side by side down the golden street. The blonde girl has long wavy golden hair catching the morning light, bright blue eyes, wearing a blue superhero shirt with a red-and-gold crest, a flowing tan coat and red skirt. Beside her, a tall dark-haired girl in a full navy blue superhero suit with a flowing red cape. Both hold iced drinks with green straws. They walk in easy, comfortable silence. Warm amber light. Storybook illustration style — soft outlines, gentle cel-shading, children's book warmth.

✂️ CUT 3 — The Little Girl Watches (6–9s)

Storybook close-up at child's eye level. A tiny girl with pigtails presses her nose against a bakery window, eyes wide with wonder as the two superhero cousins pass outside. Illustrated golden reflections on the glass. Warm, tender, magical. The moment feels frozen — like a painting inside a book. No dialogue. Just wonder.

🗣️ Only Dialogue in Part 1:

KARA: (kneeling gently to the little girl, soft smile) "The real kind. Just like you'll be someday."

✂️ CUT 4 — The Cloud Arrives (9–12s)

Illustrated wide shot. The warm golden sky above the town slowly shifts. A single large storybook storm cloud — illustrated with soft curling edges, not scary, like a cloud from a picture book — drifts in from the horizon. The cousins look up slowly. Their expressions go calm and ready. Camera tilts upward toward the cloud. The warm light dims slightly to cool lilac. Still painterly and safe — this is a children's story.

✂️ CUT 5 — Drinks Down. Capes Up. (12–15s)

Slow illustrated close-up. Two iced drinks placed gently side by side on a low stone wall. Camera pulls back in slow motion. The cousins stand tall, side by side, capes beginning to lift in the rising wind. Their silhouettes are bold and warm against the shifting sky. The frame freezes — like the last illustration before a chapter turn. Storybook page texture overlays softly. Painterly. Heroic. Tender.

prompt:
STYLE BRIEF: Ultra realistic cinematic cyberpunk. Nighttime Tokyo alley. Heavy rain. The camera doesn't watch the fight it survives it. Handheld, urgent, imperfect. Neon bleeds through rain like open wounds in the dark. Every frame feels stolen.

CHARACTER & ENVIRONMENT CONTINUITY: Both fighters maintain dark tactical hoods and black protective face masks throughout all four shots no exceptions, including during impact. The alley, rainfall intensity, and neon color palette remain locked across the entire sequence.

[00:00–00:04] SHOT 1 | THE CIRCLING
CAMERA: Extreme low-angle handheld nearly flush with the wet asphalt. The lens skims just above the surface of a shimmering puddle. The camera pushes forward slowly, predatorially, between two sets of boots.
ACTION: The two fighters circle one another in tight, measured steps. No wasted movement. No aggression yet only the terrible patience of two people who already know how this ends. Water ripples outward from each footfall like a heartbeat. Then one fighter's weight shifts. A half-second of stillness. Then a savage forward lunge, the first punch thrown like a decision that cannot be undone.
EFFECTS: Rain hammers the pavement in continuous sheets. Each footstep detonates a small explosion of water. Neon reflections red, blue, violet fracture and reassemble across the surface of every puddle. The lens catches a scatter of rain droplets mid-air, backlit against a glowing ramen sign.

[00:04–00:08] — SHOT 2 | THE EXCHANGE
CAMERA: Aggressive shoulder-level handheld, orbiting the fighters in a tight, broken arc the camera operator in the fight, not beside it. The frame cuts and tilts with each impact. Nothing is clean. Everything is alive.
ACTION: The exchange erupts. Fast hands, faster counters. Defensive slips, sharp body strikes, the ugly geometry of two trained fighters in a space too small for comfort. The camera stays inside the action close enough that fighters occasionally eclipse the frame entirely. The fight is not choreographed for the lens. The lens chases it.
EFFECTS: Every footstep detonates water. Rain streaks horizontally across the lens in blurred silver lines. Neon light catches the wet surface of tactical jackets and turns them into mirrors red on black, blue on black. The air is thick with mist and motion.

[00:08–00:12] SHOT 3 | THE MOMENT
CAMERA: Time fractures. The camera swings wide around the attacking fighter in a smooth, almost tender arc and then the world stops. Ultra slow motion descends like a held breath. The camera completes its orbit at eye level, holding on the moment of impact.

ACTION: A single punch. Thrown with everything. It connects and in slow motion, the consequence is enormous. The opponent's head snaps sideways. The hood shifts but holds. The black mask stays sealed to the face unmoved, unbroken even as the skull beneath it absorbs something catastrophic.

摄像机：极低角度手持，几乎贴着湿漉漉的沥青路面。镜头掠过闪烁的水坑表面。摄像机在两双靴子之间缓慢、掠夺性地向前推进。

摄像机：激进的肩扛式手持，以紧凑、断续的弧线绕着格斗者旋转——摄影师置身于战斗之中，而非旁观。画面随着每一次撞击而切割和倾斜。没有干净利落的动作，一切都充满张力。
动作：交锋爆发。快速的出拳，更快的反击。防御性的闪避、凌厉的身体打击，两名训练有素的格斗者在狭窄空间内展现出粗粝的格斗几何学。摄像机始终处于动作中心，距离近到格斗者偶尔会完全遮挡画面。战斗并非为了镜头而编排，而是镜头在追逐战斗。

[00:08–00:12] 镜头 3 | 瞬间
摄像机：时间破碎。摄像机以平滑、近乎温柔的弧线绕着进攻的格斗者摆动，随后世界静止。超慢动作降临，如同屏住呼吸。摄像机在视平线完成环绕，定格在撞击的瞬间。

动作：一记重拳。倾尽全力挥出。拳头击中目标，在慢动作中，后果显得极其震撼。对手的头部猛地向侧面甩去。兜帽晃动但并未脱落。黑色面罩紧贴脸部，即使头骨在面罩下承受着毁灭性的冲击，面罩依然纹丝不动，完好无损。

prompt:
- Create a single vertical anime animation development board for an original emotional short film titled "The Girl and the Lighthouse". The output must be ONE combined image containing an anime character design sheet and a cinematic storyboard page.

IMPORTANT:
→ Create fully original anime characters
→ Do not imitate any existing anime studio style directly
→ Do not resemble any copyrighted anime characters
→ Keep designs unique, soft, nostalgic, and emotionally warm

STYLE:
→ Premium anime pre-production board
→ Mix loose hand-drawn storyboard sketches with semi-rendered anime keyframes
→ Use soft watercolor-style lighting, cool sea blue and warm lighthouse gold colors, gentle shadows, red storyboard borders, blue motion arrows, handwritten production notes, timing notes, and lens notes

LAYOUT:
Clean vertical composition with 2 sections.

SECTION A — CHARACTER DESIGN SHEET

Girl:
→ A gentle anime girl with long windswept dark hair, soft blue-grey eyes, and a quietly waiting expression
→ She wears: a soft cream knit sweater, a faded blue skirt, worn white canvas shoes, and a small green scarf
→ She should feel: patient, quietly hopeful, emotionally deep, nostalgically waiting
→ Show: front view, side profile, back view, 3/4 angle
→ Expressions: patient, soft smile, quietly hopeful, calm and waiting
→ Pose standing at the cliff edge watching the lighthouse
→ Pose sitting on cliff rocks with knees drawn up
→ Pose holding her scarf as the sea wind blows

Lighthouse:
→ An old weathered lighthouse on a rocky seaside cliff — tall, worn stone, warm rotating golden light at the top
→ It should feel: steady, faithful, warm, a symbol of patient waiting and guidance
→ Show: wide view from cliff, close-up of rotating light, reflection on sea water

Add tiny handwritten notes and soft pastel anime color swatches.

SECTION B — STORYBOARD
Create 8 cinematic anime storyboard panels in a neat grid. Each panel should include handwritten camera notes, blue motion arrows, timing notes, and lens notes.

Story Beats:
→ Wide shot of an old anime seaside village at dusk — calm sea, rocky cliffs, warm lighthouse light beginning to glow
→ The girl walks alone along the cliff path toward the lighthouse as the sun sets
→ She sits down on the cliff rocks and looks out at the sea, quiet and waiting
→ Close-up of her face — patient, softly hopeful, emotionally still
→ The lighthouse light begins its slow rotation, sending warm golden light across the sea
→ She watches the light sweep across the water — each rotation steady and faithful
→ Wide shot — girl on the cliff, lighthouse above, the vast calm sea below, warm dusk light
→ Emotional ending — the lighthouse light sweeps across her face one more time, warm and gentle, the whole sea glowing behind her

Environment:
Old anime seaside village at dusk. Rocky cliffs, calm sea, old stone lighthouse. Warm golden dusk light on the water. Sea wind, distant waves, peaceful nostalgic coastal atmosphere.

prompt:
**SCENE**
Seedance 2.0 slice-of-life, 15 seconds. @ image1 = Main Subject. Preserve exact face, hairstyle, features, skin tone, and body proportions throughout.

**OUTFIT:** Oversized olive sleeveless linen shirt loosely tucked into wide-leg dusty burgundy trousers, flat brown leather sandals, small gold hoop earrings. Shirt naturally damp/sweat-stained at collar, underarms, chest. Hair loosely down, natural waves, few strands sticking to face and neck. Completely unglamorous.

**LOCATION:** Authentic traditional Korean rural village. Dirt/gravel paths. Mossy stone walls. Hanok houses with aged clay tile roofs. Wooden fences. Overgrown grass. Gnarled old trees. Stone water basin. Hanging dried chili peppers. Cracked stone steps. Ceramic facial jars. Free-roaming roosters. Morning cooking smoke. Dense hillside vegetation. Zero modern elements.

**CAMERA:** Late-2000s flip cam vlog. Heavy handheld shake. Imperfect reframing. Subject frequently off-center or cropped. Aggressive autofocus hunting. Lens breathing. Strong exposure swings. Rolling shutter. Heavy motion blur. Warm faded washed-out muddy tones. Blown highlights. Crushed blacks. Heavy digital noise and compression artifacts. Maximum home-video imperfection.

---

**00:00–00:02** — Mossy stone wall path. Loose sweaty arm's-length self-shot. Woman smiles tiredly, speaks casually to lens while walking. Weeds brush past. Camera tilts mid-walk.

**00:02–00:04** — Hanok courtyard. Handheld from behind. Woman walks through; stray dog trots alongside. Jangdok jars along wall. Morning smoke drifts low.

**00:04–00:06** — Stone water basin. Handheld close. Woman crouches, splashes cool water on sweaty face and neck, exhales with relief, laughs softly. Focus hunts aggressively.

**00:06–00:08** — Gnarled tree, stone wall. Low handheld. Woman crouches, hand-feeds stray dog. Camera breathes between her face and the dog.

**00:08–00:10** — Village path. Handheld side tracking. Woman walks slowly, wipes sweat from forehead, glances around. Rooster crosses ahead. Camera sways, reframes late.

**00:10–00:12** — Shaded hanok exterior, stacked ceramic pots. Woman sits on cracked stone step, sips from battered tin cup. Shirt visibly damp. Elderly woman moves in background. Breeze lifts hair.

**00:12–00:15** — Dirt path near gnarled tree. Self-shot. Woman raises camera to sweaty face, laughs tiredly, speaks casually, gives small wave. Recording cuts abruptly mid-moment.

---

No posing. No fashion look. No perfect composition. No stabilization. No cinematic glamour. No modern grading. No music.

**AUDIO:** Morning birds, roosters, distant village chatter, dog, water on stone, crackling fire, footsteps on dirt, rustling leaves, wind, ceramic sounds.

**16:9.**

path: prompts/真人/特效向/科幻/youmind-6606--外星军队基地伏击.md
prompt:
A jungle base at night, deep in thick wet rainforest. Tents, sandbags, floodlights, a fenced yard with a big diesel generator and fuel drums, and a tall watchtower. A giant alien — brownish-black, slimy, with long whipping tentacles — has attacked the base, wrapped its tentacles around the big generator, and is dragging a soldier across the yard toward it. On the watchtower, a gunner stands at a mounted gun. Sound: humming generator, wet tentacles slapping, shouting men, the alien's low roar, radio voices.

Shot 1 (0–3s) — THE HOOK: Low shot across the floodlit yard. The giant alien crushes the diesel generator in one set of tentacles while another drags a soldier across the mud by his legs. He claws at the ground. Men run between the tents. One shouts into his radio: "IT'S DRAGGING HIM TO THE GENERATOR!"

Shot 2 (3–6s): Up on the watchtower. The gunner swings his mounted gun toward the alien, but holds his fire — the soldier still in the tentacles, fuel drums everywhere. He calls down on the radio: "Break loose! Roll clear!"

Shot 3 (6–9s): At the soldier. He pulls a knife and slashes the slimy tentacle around his legs, breaks free, and rolls clear across the yard. The alien, now empty-handed, lets go of the generator and slides forward into the open middle of the floodlit yard, rearing up tall and clear in the mud.

Shot 4 (9–13s) — BIG SLOW-MOTION MOMENT: The alien is out in the open now, the fuel drums right behind it. The gunner fires. Bullet time — a stream of heavy rounds flies across the yard in slow motion, smoke and shell cases hanging in the air, smashing into the alien and tearing into the fuel drums behind it. The drums burst — a huge fireball blooming around the alien.

Shot 5 (13–15s): Time snaps back. The whole yard lights up as the fuel drums and the alien go up in one rolling fireball, fire and slime shooting into the night sky. Soldiers shield their faces in the mud as the rescued man scrambles clear.

variants.text:
深夜，深处潮湿茂密的雨林中的丛林基地。帐篷、沙袋、探照灯、带有大型柴油发电机和燃料桶的围栏院落，以及一座高耸的瞭望塔。一只巨大的外星生物——棕黑色、黏糊糊的，长着长长的鞭状触手——袭击了基地，用触手缠住了大型发电机，并将一名士兵拖过院子向其靠近。在瞭望塔上，一名炮手站在车载机枪旁。音效：发电机嗡嗡声、湿滑触手的拍打声、士兵的呼喊声、外星生物的低吼声、无线电通话声。

镜头 1 (0–3 秒) — 钩子：穿过探照灯照亮的院子的低角度镜头。巨大的外星生物用一组触手压碎了柴油发电机，同时另一组触手将一名士兵的双腿拖过泥地。他拼命抓挠地面。士兵们在帐篷间奔跑。一人对着无线电大喊：“它正把他拖向发电机！”

镜头 2 (3–6 秒)：瞭望塔上。炮手将车载机枪转向外星生物，但没有开火——因为士兵还在触手中，周围到处都是燃料桶。他通过无线电向下喊道：“挣脱！快滚开！”

镜头 3 (6–9 秒)：士兵特写。他拔出刀，割开了缠在腿上的黏滑触手，挣脱束缚，滚过院子。外星生物此时已空手，松开发电机，滑向探照灯照亮的院子中央，在泥泞中高高耸起，身形清晰可见。

镜头 4 (9–13 秒) — 大规模慢动作时刻：外星生物现在处于空旷地带，身后就是燃料桶。炮手开火。子弹时间——一串重型子弹在慢动作中飞过院子，烟雾和弹壳悬浮在空中，击中外星生物并撕裂了它身后的燃料桶。燃料桶爆炸——巨大的火球在外星生物周围绽放。

A moonlit forest covered in mist. A skilled female assassin, Rin, sprints through the trees with incredible speed while armed soldiers chase her. The camera switches between close-ups of her determined eyes, her boots hitting the ground, and the pursuers crashing through branches.
Enemy: "There she is! Don't let her escape!"

SECTION 3 (30–45s) — The Final Leap

Commander: "You're out of options. Surrender."
Rin slowly turns to face them, completely fearless.
Rin: "You think this is the end..."
She steps backward toward the edge.
Rin: "...this is only the beginning."
She leaps off the cliff in slow motion. The soldiers rush to the edge and look down.

SCENE 2 (4–8s): Introduction Performance — Three-Blade Warrior
The male Three-Blade swordsman (Image2) stands on a separate floating platform across the lake. His swords are revealed one by one in a disciplined sequence. Green wind energy subtly flows around his movements. Camera focuses on strength, discipline, and precision.

SCENE 3 (8–12s): Mutual Awareness
Both characters stop their demonstrations and lock eyes across the lake. The atmosphere becomes tense. Wind intensifies. Water begins to ripple between them. Camera slowly zooms out to reveal distance and scale of the battlefield.

Both warriors simultaneously step onto the water surface, running across it with controlled speed. Each character creates independent ripples and splash trails. No shared motion path. Camera tracking shot follows their separate trajectories as they close distance.

They meet mid-air above the lake. A powerful collision of sakura-pink energy and green wind force explodes outward, distorting the water surface below like shattered glass. Camera performs slow 360 orbit around impact point.

SCENE 6 (20–24s): Aftermath
Both land on opposite sides of the lake, standing still. Mist slowly rises. The lake returns to silence. Final slow pull-back reveals the vast dark battlefield.
